title: Optimal Planning in a Dynamic World
title_zh: Optimal planning in a dynamic world

paragraphs.en: Background: We address the problem of planning when the set of feasible states or actions changes over time. For example, in the problem of path planning among moving obstacles (sometimes known as SIPP), the feasibility of being at a particular location can change as the obstacles move. Or, the action of boarding a particular train is feasible only while it is stopped at the station. This dynamism means that the optimal plan and its duration can change depending on when execution begins. In practice, execution start time is often unknown until planning has completed or another agent gives the go-ahead. However, most prior planning work either ignores dynamism or assumes a known start time. This makes it straightforward to assess state and action feasibility but is impractical for some applications.
paragraphs.zh: 背景：我们研究的是在可行状态或动作集合随时间变化时的规划问题。 例如，在移动障碍物之间的路径规划问题中（有时称为 SIPP），由于障碍物的移动，处于特定位置的可行性可能会发生变化。 或者，登上某列特定火车这一动作只有在列车停靠车站时才是可行的。 这种动态性意味着最优计划及其执行时长可能会因执行开始时间的不同而改变。 在实践中，执行开始时间通常在规划完成或另一个智能体给出许可之前都是未知的。 然而，大多数早期的规划研究要么忽略了这种动态性，要么假设了已知的开始时间。 这使得评估状态和动作的可行性变得简单，但对于某些应用来说并不可行。

paragraphs.en: Objectives: In this paper, we relax the assumption of a known start time. We define the setting of any-start-time planning and provide algorithms for it.
paragraphs.zh: 目标：在本文中，我们放宽了起始时间已知的假设。 我们定义了任意起始时间规划的设定，并为此提供了算法。

sents.en: Objectives: In this paper, we relax the assumption of a known start time.
sents.zh: 目标：在本文中，我们放宽了起始时间已知的假设。

sents.en: We define the setting of any-start-time planning and provide algorithms for it.
sents.zh: 我们定义了任意起始时间规划的设定，并为此提供了算法。

paragraphs.en: Methods: We present a data structure called a compound arrival time function (cATF) that compactly encodes the optimal plan as a function of start time. We provide general-purpose planning algorithms, based on heuristic graph search, that assemble cATFs by propagating functions along edges instead of scalar costs.
paragraphs.zh: 方法：我们提出了一种名为复合到达时间函数（cATF）的数据结构，该结构将最优计划以出发时间的函数形式进行紧凑编码。 我们提供基于启发式图搜索的通用规划算法，这些算法通过沿边传播函数而非标量成本来构建 cATF。

sents.en: Methods: We present a data structure called a compound arrival time function (cATF) that compactly encodes the optimal plan as a function of start time.
sents.zh: 方法：我们提出了一种名为复合到达时间函数（cATF）的数据结构，该结构将最优计划以出发时间的函数形式进行紧凑编码。

sents.en: We provide general-purpose planning algorithms, based on heuristic graph search, that assemble cATFs by propagating functions along edges instead of scalar costs.
sents.zh: 我们提供基于启发式图搜索的通用规划算法，这些算法通过沿边传播函数而非标量成本来构建 cATF。

paragraphs.en: Results: We prove that the size of a cATF is at most linear in the problem size. An experimental evaluation of an implementation for the specific problem of SIPP shows that, on difficult problems, agents that rely on replanning often fail, while any-start-time algorithms using cATFs can quickly look up the optimal plan once the execution start time is known.
paragraphs.zh: 结果：我们证明了 cATF 的大小最多与问题规模呈线性关系。 针对 SIPP 这一特定问题的实现进行了实验评估，结果表明，在难题上，依赖重新规划的智能体通常会失败，而使用 cATF 的任何起始时间算法一旦知道执行起始时间，就能快速查询出最优计划。

sents.en: Results: We prove that the size of a cATF is at most linear in the problem size.
sents.zh: 结果：我们证明了 cATF 的大小最多与问题规模呈线性关系。

sents.en: An experimental evaluation of an implementation for the specific problem of SIPP shows that, on difficult problems, agents that rely on replanning often fail, while any-start-time algorithms using cATFs can quickly look up the optimal plan once the execution start time is known.
sents.zh: 针对 SIPP 这一特定问题的实现进行了实验评估，结果表明，在难题上，依赖重新规划的智能体通常会失败，而使用 cATF 的任何起始时间算法一旦知道执行起始时间，就能快速查询出最优计划。

paragraphs.en: Conclusions: By enabling efficient representations and reasoning for time-dependent plans, this work provides a foundation for planning in dynamic worlds.
paragraphs.zh: 结论：通过为依赖时间的规划实现高效的表示与推理，本研究为动态世界中的规划奠定了基础。

paragraphs.en: Many applications of planning involve a dynamic world. For example, buses and trains move from stop to stop and shopkeepers open and close their stores without any action on our part. Buses and trains can only be boarded after they arrive and before they depart and groceries can only be purchased when the store is open, so in general, the optimal plan can depend on when execution will begin. Traditionally, planning algorithms have either assumed a known execution start time or assumed that the world is static except for the agent, so its plans will forever remain valid. However, this assumption of a static world or a known start time is frequently violated in real-world settings. Examples include when the start of execution must wait for planning to complete, for some external event to occur, or for the agent to receive permission to act. In such situations, it can be preferable to have a valid plan at the ready, rather than needing to wait until the desired start time is known to even begin planning.
paragraphs.zh: 许多规划应用都涉及一个动态变化的世界。 例如，公交车和火车会在站点之间移动，店主也会自行开店和关门，这些都不需要我们采取任何行动。 只有在公交车和火车到达后、发车前才能上车，而商品也只有在商店营业时才能购买，因此总体而言，最优规划可能取决于执行开始的时间。 传统上，规划算法要么假设执行开始时间是已知的，要么假设除了智能体之外世界是静态的，因此其规划将永远有效。 然而，在现实世界中，这种关于世界静态或执行开始时间已知的假设常常不成立。 例如，执行可能需要等待规划完成、某个外部事件发生，或者智能体获得行动许可之后才能开始。 在这种情况下，提前准备好一个有效的规划可能更为理想，而不是等到预期开始时间确定之后才开始进行规划。

paragraphs.en: In this paper we describe how to plan for all start-times. The resulting any-start-time plan has many uses. It enables reasoning about the effects of delays, both during planning and online during execution. In order to apply this approach, we simply need to be willing to represent the problem using a state space where states and actions are either safe or unsafe in continuous time. In return for using this state-space representation, our planner efficiently finds an any-start-time plan — a set of optimal plans for every execution start-time.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们描述了如何为所有开始时间进行规划。 由此生成的任意开始时间规划具有多种用途。 它使得我们能够在规划阶段以及执行过程中的在线运行阶段，对延迟的影响进行推理。 为了应用这种方法，我们只需愿意使用一种状态空间来表示问题，其中状态和行动在连续时间中要么是安全的，要么是不安全的。 作为使用这种状态空间表示的回报，我们的规划器能够高效地找到一个任意开始时间规划——即针对每个执行开始时间的一组最优规划。

sents.zh: 在本文中，我们描述了如何为所有开始时间进行规划。

sents.en: In return for using this state-space representation, our planner efficiently finds an any-start-time plan — a set of optimal plans for every execution start-time.
sents.zh: 作为使用这种状态空间表示的回报，我们的规划器能够高效地找到一个任意开始时间规划——即针对每个执行开始时间的一组最优规划。

paragraphs.en: The dynamic world can be viewed as a source of uncertainty for the planner, one approach to handling uncertainty in planning is to plan for all eventualities. This approach, called universal planning, has been considered “an (almost) universally bad idea” [ 17 ] because universal plans generally grow exponentially with problem size. The time-dependent shortest path problem (TDSP) [ 12 ] is one example of universal planning; it handles uncertainty in the form of an unknown start time. In the TDSP, the planner’s objective is to find shortest duration paths for all possible departure times of the agent in a graph with time-dependent edge costs. When the TDSP edges are first-in first-out (i.e., an agent departing later can not arrive earlier), the number of optimal plans in the any-start-time policy solving a TDSP is super-polynomial ( n Θ ⁡ ( log ⁡ ( n ) ) n^{\Theta(\log(n))} ) in the size of the graph [ 16 ] . But hang with us for a minute.
paragraphs.zh: 动态世界可以被视为规划者面临的不确定性的来源，而处理规划中不确定性的方法之一是为所有可能情况制定计划。 这种方法被称为通用规划，它被视作“一个（几乎）普遍糟糕的主意”[17]，因为通用计划通常会随着问题规模的增大而呈指数级增长。 时间依赖最短路径问题（TDSP）[12] 是通用规划的一个例子；它以未知的出发时间形式处理不确定性。 在 TDSP 中，规划者的目标是为一幅具有时间依赖边成本的图中智能体的所有可能出发时间找到持续时间最短的路径。 当 TDSP 的边遵循先进先出原则（即，较晚出发的智能体无法更早到达）时，解决 TDSP 的任何出发时间策略中的最优计划数量会超过多项式级别，达到 n^{\Theta(\log(n))} [16]。 但请先听我们解释一下。

paragraphs.en: One popular planning setting with time-dependent edge costs is so-called safe interval path planning (SIPP) [ 33 ] , where being in a state or taking an action is either safe or unsafe depending on the time. (Despite the name, nothing in SIPP is specific to path planning or to safety and, as we explain further below, it applies very generally to planning with dynamic action applicability.) While previous SIPP algorithms plan for only a single start time, in this paper we introduce any-start-time planning , which is a generalization of the SIPP problem to plan for all start times, rather than assuming a single known start time. Any-start-time planning is a subclass of the TDSP that has better solution complexity. While the general TDSP can have a solution that is super-polynomial, we will see below that any-start-time planning is a subset of universal planning that is actually a good idea, because the resulting universal plan grows only linearly with problem size. As time also progresses linearly, this means it can be applied to defer the commitment to an execution start time to be online, rather than an offline prerequisite to planning. Figure 1 illustrates the relationship between SIPP and the TDSP, with our any-start-time planning being the linear complexity overlap. In this paper, we present general representations and algorithms for handling planning domains in which the applicability of actions can change over time and we show via a specific example implementation for grid path planning that they can be more effective in dynamic worlds than replanning.
paragraphs.zh: 一种流行的、具有时间相关边成本的规划设定是所谓的“安全区间路径规划”（SIPP）[33]，其中处于某个状态或执行某个动作是否安全取决于当前时间。 （尽管名称如此，SIPP 本身并不局限于路径规划或安全性；正如我们将在下文进一步解释的，它非常普遍地适用于动态动作可用性的规划问题。）虽然以往的 SIPP 算法仅针对单一起始时间进行规划，但本文我们引入了“任意起始时间规划”，这是 SIPP 问题的一种推广形式，旨在为所有可能的起始时间进行规划，而非假设存在一个已知的单一起始时间。 任意起始时间规划是 TDSP 的一个子类，其解的复杂度更低。 虽然一般的 TDSP 可能产生超多项式复杂度的解，但我们将看到，任意起始时间规划实际上是通用规划的一个有效子集，因为由此生成的通用规划方案仅以问题规模的线性程度增长。 由于时间本身也是线性推进的，这意味着该方法可以将执行起始时间的确定推迟到在线阶段，而无需在规划前作为离线前提条件。 图 1 展示了 SIPP 与 TDSP 之间的关系，其中我们的任意起始时间规划构成了两者之间具有线性复杂度的交集部分。 在本文中，我们提出了处理动态规划领域的一般性表示方法和算法——在这些领域中，动作的可用性可能随时间变化；并通过一个用于网格路径规划的具体实现示例表明，在动态环境中，这些方法可能比重新规划更为有效。

paragraphs.en: Consider a food delivery robot planning its delivery route (Figure 2 , left panel). The robot has two roads that it can choose between, taking 10 and 20 minutes respectively, to reach the delivery target. However, the faster of the two roads is blocked from 3:20 to 3:40 by a freight train. The robot must wait for a human chef to finish preparing the meal before it can be delivered. If we know ahead of time when the food will be ready, i.e., the starting time, we can find the optimal plan assuming departure at that time. This can be done by searching our road network for the earliest possible arrival time at each location, until we reach the goal. But what if we lack clairvoyance and do not know the departure time in advance? If we want to take advantage of the idle time before the cooking is complete, we can consider a range of possible departure times.
paragraphs.zh: 假设一个食品配送智能体正在规划其配送路线（图2，左图）。 该智能体有两条道路可供选择，分别需要10分钟和20分钟才能到达配送目标。 然而，这两条路中较快的一条在3:20到3:40期间被一列货运列车堵塞。 该智能体必须等待人类厨师完成餐食准备后才能进行配送。 如果我们提前知道食物何时准备好，即出发时间，那么我们就可以在假设于该时间出发的情况下找到最优计划。 这可以通过在我们的道路网络中搜索每个位置最早可能的到达时间来实现，直到抵达目标地点。 但如果我们缺乏预知能力，无法提前知道出发时间呢？ 如果我们想利用烹饪完成前的空闲时间，就可以考虑一系列可能的出发时间。

sents.en: Consider a food delivery robot planning its delivery route (Figure 2 , left panel).
sents.zh: 假设一个食品配送智能体正在规划其配送路线（图2，左图）。

sents.en: The robot has two roads that it can choose between, taking 10 and 20 minutes respectively, to reach the delivery target.
sents.zh: 该智能体有两条道路可供选择，分别需要10分钟和20分钟才能到达配送目标。

sents.en: However, the faster of the two roads is blocked from 3:20 to 3:40 by a freight train.
sents.zh: 然而，这两条路中较快的一条在3:20到3:40期间被一列货运列车堵塞。

sents.en: The robot must wait for a human chef to finish preparing the meal before it can be delivered.
sents.zh: 该智能体必须等待人类厨师完成餐食准备后才能进行配送。

sents.en: If we know ahead of time when the food will be ready, i.e., the starting time, we can find the optimal plan assuming departure at that time.
sents.zh: 如果我们提前知道食物何时准备好，即出发时间，那么我们就可以在假设于该时间出发的情况下找到最优计划。

sents.en: This can be done by searching our road network for the earliest possible arrival time at each location, until we reach the goal.
sents.zh: 这可以通过在我们的道路网络中搜索每个位置最早可能的到达时间来实现，直到抵达目标地点。

sents.en: But what if we lack clairvoyance and do not know the departure time in advance?
sents.zh: 但如果我们缺乏预知能力，无法提前知道出发时间呢？

sents.en: If we want to take advantage of the idle time before the cooking is complete, we can consider a range of possible departure times.
sents.zh: 如果我们想利用烹饪完成前的空闲时间，就可以考虑一系列可能的出发时间。

paragraphs.en: The right panel of Figure 2 shows the optimal arrival time of the delivery robot, plotted as a function of departure time. There is a family of trajectories, labeled as segment A in Figure 2 , that represents the same plan along the faster road, just with different departure times. If the robot departs at 3:10, it can take the fast road to arrive at 3:20. Similarly, if it departs at 3:15 it will arrive at 3:25. However, the train blocking the faster road causes a breakpoint in the arrival time function at 3:20, where the segment labeled B corresponds to the family of plans in which the delivery robot is better off taking the slower road. At 3:30 there is another breakpoint in the arrival time function, where segment C has a constant arrival time because it is faster for the delivery robot to wait for the train to pass and then take the faster road. At 3:40 the train crossing opens and the arrival time function of segment D once again increases proportionally to departure time. This structure — segments with slope of 0 0 or 1 1 , corresponding to waiting or acting — arises due to the binary nature of safety in our problem.

paragraphs.en: To plan for any start time efficiently, we represent the planning problem as having safe intervals on states and actions when it is possible for the agent to be safely in the state or begin executing the action. We search using g ⁡ ( t ) g(t) and f ⁡ ( t ) f(t) values that are functions of time, rather than scalar values as is typical for A* and related searches. The functions, track the cumulative effects of the deadlines and constraints imparted by each safe interval the plan encounters. The result of planning is an any-start-time plan, which is itself a function of time. Our approach to solving any-start-time planning is (with some nuance related to tie-breaking) a form of cost-algebraic A* [ 13 ] where costs are functions of time that accumulate through function composition rather than scalar summation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了高效地规划任何开始时间，我们将规划问题表示为：当智能体能够安全处于某个状态或开始执行某个动作时，该状态和动作上存在安全区间。 我们使用随时间变化的 g(t) 和 f(t) 值进行搜索，而不是像 A* 及相关搜索中常见的标量值。 这些函数会追踪规划过程中遇到的每个安全区间所施加的截止日期和约束条件的累积影响。 规划的结果是一个任意开始时间的规划方案，其本身也是一个随时间变化的函数。 我们解决任意开始时间规划问题的方法（在打破平局方面存在一些细微差别）是一种成本代数 A* [13]，其中成本是随时间变化的函数，通过函数组合而非标量求和进行累积。

paragraphs.en: We begin by reviewing the foundational prior work for any-start-time planning: SIPP and the TDSP. We then present Augmented SIPP, a novel heuristic search algorithm that uses functions of time instead of scalars for the g g values of the SIPP search. We then formally define the any-start-time planning problem and present RePEAT, an algorithm that solves the any-start-time planning problem by repeatedly running Augmented SIPP to build a set of optimal plans covering all departure times up to a monotonically increasing time horizon. We then prove the optimality and complexity of these algorithms, adapting prior results for cost-algebraic heuristic search and the TDSP. Finally, we evaluate the empirical performance of our methods and discuss some possible applications for any-start-time planning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先回顾适用于任何开始时间规划的基础性工作：SIPP 和 TDSP。 接着，我们介绍增强型 SIPP（Augmented SIPP），这是一种新颖的启发式搜索算法，在 SIPP 搜索的 g 值中使用时间的函数而非标量。 随后，我们正式定义任何开始时间规划问题，并介绍 RePEAT 算法。该算法通过重复运行增强型 SIPP，构建一个覆盖所有出发时间直至单调递增时间范围的最优计划集合，从而解决该规划问题。 然后，我们通过调整成本代数启发式搜索和 TDSP 的既有成果，证明了这些算法的最优性和复杂度。 最后，我们评估了所提方法的实证表现，并讨论了任何开始时间规划的一些潜在应用。

paragraphs.en: We begin with SIPP, which concerns offline planning with moving obstacles and a known start time. We then describe the TDSP problem, which considers finding shortest paths on a graph with time-varying edge costs. While prior work has described situations where the TDSP can be solved efficiently, to our knowledge we are the first to observe that the subset of the TDSP with linearly-sized solutions corresponds to the SIPP state space that is popular in the planning community. We call this intersection any-start-time planning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 SIPP 开始，它涉及存在移动障碍物且起始时间已知的离线规划问题。 接着我们描述 TDSP 问题，该问题旨在寻找具有时变边成本的图中的最短路径。 尽管先前的研究已经描述了能够高效解决 TDSP 的情况，但据我们所知，我们是首次观察到：TDSP 中那些解集规模呈线性的子问题，恰好对应于规划领域广泛使用的 SIPP 状态空间。 我们将这种交集称为任意起始时间规划。

paragraphs.en: SIPP [ 33 ] is a popular way to formalize the problem of navigating in a dynamic world (often moving obstacles). In SIPP, the agent and obstacles move in discrete space and continuous time and the states and actions are either safe or unsafe at every point in time. All future movements of dynamic obstacles in the environment are encoded by their impact on the time-dependent safety of states and actions. We refer to this original continuous, infinite state space as the naive state space. A naive state s n ​ a ​ i ​ v ​ e = ⟨ x , t ⟩ s_{naive}=\langle x,t\rangle , consists of a configuration x x and point in time t t . Likewise, a naive action a n ​ a ​ i ​ v ​ e = ⟨ x , x ′ , t ⟩ a_{naive}=\langle x,x^{\prime},t\rangle , consists of a source configuration x x , destination configuration x ′ x^{\prime} , and a departure time t t , when the action begins. Exploring this infinite naive state space is intractable, so [ 33 ] discretize the naive state space into the SIPP state space by grouping neighboring safe states (and actions) together into safe intervals. In the SIPP state space, the time points in the naive states (and actions) are replaced by a continuous interval of times when the configuration (or action) is safe to occupy (or begin).
paragraphs.zh: SIPP [ 33 ] 是一种将动态世界（通常存在移动的障碍物）中的导航问题形式化的常用方法。 在 SIPP 中，智能体和障碍物在离散空间与连续时间中移动，且在任何时刻的状态和行动都是安全的或不安全的。 环境中动态障碍物的所有未来移动，都通过其对状态和行动随时间变化的安全性所产生的影响来编码。 我们将这种原始的连续无限状态空间称为“朴素状态空间”。 一个朴素状态 s_{naive}=\langle x,t\rangle 由配置 x 和时间点 t 组成。 同样，一个朴素行动 a_{naive}=\langle x,x^{\prime},t\rangle 由源配置 x、目标配置 x^{\prime} 以及行动开始的时间点 t 组成。 探索这种无限的朴素状态空间是不可行的，因此 [ 33 ] 通过将相邻的安全状态（和行动）分组为安全区间，将朴素状态空间离散化为 SIPP 状态空间。 在 SIPP 状态空间中，朴素状态（和行动）中的时间点被替换为一个连续的时间区间，表示该配置（或行动）可以被安全地占据（或开始执行）。

paragraphs.en: We depart from prior work in two ways. First, SIPP has generally been described as having safe intervals solely for states. However, as is done in multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) with continuous time [ 2 ] , we also use safe intervals on actions. The example in Figure 3 shows the benefit of safe intervals on actions, as the safety of the agent depends on the action the agent takes: if it moves to the left, it will be safer for longer than if it moves to the right or stays in place. Generally, SIPP has been applied to problems that require some form of collision checking, which implicitly performs the same role as the action safe intervals. Although we do not explicitly consider how to generate safe intervals in this paper, the version of SIPP with safe intervals on both states and actions may be easier in many cases to generate safe intervals for than the version of SIPP that only has intervals on states.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个方面与先前的研究有所不同。 首先，SIPP 通常被描述为仅针对状态设置安全区间。 然而，正如在连续时间多智能体路径规划（MAPF）[2] 中所做的那样，我们还将安全区间应用于动作。 图 3 中的示例展示了将安全区间应用于动作的优势，因为智能体的安全性取决于其采取的动作：如果它向左移动，会比向右移动或停留在原地更安全更长时间。 通常，SIPP 被应用于需要某种形式碰撞检测的问题，而碰撞检测在功能上隐式地起到了与动作安全区间相同的作用。 尽管本文并未明确探讨如何生成安全区间，但在许多情况下，同时为状态和动作设置安全区间的 SIPP 版本可能比仅针对状态设置安全区间的版本更容易生成安全区间。

sents.zh: 我们在两个方面与先前的研究有所不同。

sents.en: First, SIPP has generally been described as having safe intervals solely for states.
sents.zh: 首先，SIPP 通常被描述为仅针对状态设置安全区间。

sents.en: However, as is done in multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) with continuous time [ 2 ] , we also use safe intervals on actions.
sents.zh: 然而，正如在连续时间多智能体路径规划（MAPF）[2] 中所做的那样，我们还将安全区间应用于动作。

sents.en: The example in Figure 3 shows the benefit of safe intervals on actions, as the safety of the agent depends on the action the agent takes: if it moves to the left, it will be safer for longer than if it moves to the right or stays in place.
sents.zh: 图 3 中的示例展示了将安全区间应用于动作的优势，因为智能体的安全性取决于其采取的动作：如果它向左移动，会比向右移动或停留在原地更安全更长时间。

sents.en: Generally, SIPP has been applied to problems that require some form of collision checking, which implicitly performs the same role as the action safe intervals.
sents.zh: 通常，SIPP 被应用于需要某种形式碰撞检测的问题，而碰撞检测在功能上隐式地起到了与动作安全区间相同的作用。

sents.en: Although we do not explicitly consider how to generate safe intervals in this paper, the version of SIPP with safe intervals on both states and actions may be easier in many cases to generate safe intervals for than the version of SIPP that only has intervals on states.
sents.zh: 尽管本文并未明确探讨如何生成安全区间，但在许多情况下，同时为状态和动作设置安全区间的 SIPP 版本可能比仅针对状态设置安全区间的版本更容易生成安全区间。

paragraphs.en: Second, SIPP has generally been applied in the context of grid pathfinding. However, this SIPP representation is more broadly applicable than the terms safe and path planning would suggest. While a safe interval can often literally mean system safety (i.e., collision-free), it can be interpreted more broadly as representing any sort of dynamic applicability of, expiration of, or deadlines on, states and actions. SIPP applies to any setting that can be described by binary safety of configurations and/or actions in continuous time. SIPP is a state-of-the-art approach in settings such as: MAPF [ 1 , 29 , 37 ] , railway planning [ 21 , 30 ] , and planning for robotic manipulators [ 25 , 31 ] . Our novel enhancement of SIPP, Augmented SIPP (see Section 3 ) is a drop in replacement for SIPP which returns extra information with no overhead (see Section 7.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 其次，SIPP 通常应用于网格路径规划的场景中。 然而，这种 SIPP 表示方法的应用范围比“安全”和“路径规划”这些术语所暗示的更为广泛。 虽然“安全区间”通常字面意义上指系统安全（即无碰撞），但它也可以被更广泛地解释为表示状态和行动的任何动态适用性、有效期或截止日期。 SIPP 适用于任何可以通过连续时间中配置和/或行动的二元安全性来描述的场景。 SIPP 是以下场景中的前沿方法：MAPF [1, 29, 37]、铁路规划 [21, 30] 以及机器人操作臂的规划 [25, 31]。 我们对 SIPP 提出的新颖增强方法——增强型 SIPP（见第 3 节）是 SIPP 的直接替代方案，能够在不增加额外开销的情况下返回更多信息（见第 7.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: A state s = ⟨ x , i ⟩ ∈ S s=\langle x,i\rangle\in S has configuration x x and safe interval i i . Each state represents an interval of time ( i i ) that the configuration ( x x ) is safe. A configuration represents the atemporal component of the state, such as the location of the agent (e.g., the restaurant or apartment in our example in Figure 2 , the configuration of a robotic arm, or a set of true fluents in PDDL planning). Many states may be associated with the same configuration, but they will have different non-overlapping safe intervals. For example, if the restaurant our food delivery robot picks up from closes each night and the robot is not allowed to stay at the restaurant while it is closed, then each day the restaurant is open would be represented its own state with a safe interval from the start to the end of business. 2 2 2 While a state representation that allows a single state to incorporate multiple safe intervals corresponding to the same configuration is certainly possible, we find it clearer to allow only one interval per state.
paragraphs.zh: 状态 s = ⟨ x , i ⟩ ∈ S 具有配置 x 和安全区间 i。 每个状态表示一个时间区间（i），在该区间内配置（x）是安全的。 配置表示状态中非时间相关的部分，例如智能体的位置（如我们在图 2 中的示例里的餐厅或公寓）、机械臂的配置，或 PDDL 规划中一组为真的谓词。 许多状态可能与相同的配置相关联，但它们将具有不同的、互不重叠的安全区间。 例如，如果我们的食物配送机器人取餐的餐厅每晚都会关闭，并且机器人不允许在餐厅关闭期间留在那里，那么餐厅每天营业的时间段都将由一个独立的状态来表示，其安全区间从营业开始时间持续到结束时间。尽管允许单个状态包含与同一配置对应的多个安全区间的状态表示当然是可能的，但我们认为每个状态只允许一个区间会更清晰。

A plan p p is a sequence of SIPP edges, p 1 , … , p n p_{1},\ldots,p_{n} , where the destination of p i p_{i} is the source of p i + 1 p_{i+1} . A plan is valid at time t t if and only if an agent departing on or after time t t can traverse the edges p 1 ​ … ​ n p_{1\ldots n} safely, specifically no edge p i p_{i} will make the agent arrive too late to be safe at the destination of p i p_{i} and then safely take the next edge p i + 1 p_{i+1} . We retain these assumptions throughout this paper.

paragraphs.en: A simple example of a SIPP problem instance is shown in Figure 3 . An obstacle O O approaches from the right of the agent A A , moving to the left with unit speed. A A is capable of moving at half the speed of O O . The safe intervals of states represent when it is safe to be in the corresponding location, while the edge intervals represent when it is safe to initiate movement actions between them. In this example, the three SIPP states of interest are: s 0 = ⟨ 0 , [ 0 , 3 ) ⟩ s_{0}=\langle 0,[0,3)\rangle , s 1 = ⟨ 1 , [ 0 , 2 ) ⟩ s_{1}=\langle 1,[0,2)\rangle , and s 2 = ⟨ 2 , [ 0 , 1 ) ⟩ s_{2}=\langle 2,[0,1)\rangle , where the ends of the safe intervals correspond to the arrival times of the obstacle. The potential edges corresponding to the agent’s routes to leave s 1 s_{1} are: e 1 , 0 = ⟨ s 1 , s 0 , [ 0 , 1 ) ⟩ e_{1,0}=\langle s_{1},s_{0},[0,1)\rangle (the obstacle arrives at t = 1 t=1 , marking the end of the safe interval), and e 1 , 2 = ⟨ s 1 , s 2 , [ 0 , 0 ) ⟩ e_{1,2}=\langle s_{1},s_{2},[0,0)\rangle (leaving on or after t = 0 t=0 will result in the agent being clobbered by the obstacle before finishing the move). Because e 1 , 2 e_{1,2} is never safe, only e 0 , 1 e_{0,1} is retained as a valid edge in the SIPP graph.

paragraphs.en: We make the observation that SIPP problems are a special case of time-dependent shortest path (TDSP) problems on implicit graphs, where there is a single known execution time and a restricted set of edge costs. TDSPs model networks that have time-dependent edge costs. They are frequently applied to roads, communication, and other networks where congestion can vary with the time of day. [ 7 ] introduced a discrete-time version of the TDSP, along with a modified Bellman-Ford algorithm to solve it. [ 12 ] observed that Dijkstra’s algorithm [ 11 ] could be trivially applied. Furthermore, [ 12 ] observed that it was unnecessary to discretize time, instead labeling each node with the upper bound on its earliest arrival-time. This is identical to the state-dominance relation used by the SIPP algorithm [ 33 ] and the one-to-many algorithm described by [ 12 ] adapts Dijkstra’s algorithm in the same way that SIPP adapts A*. We adapt the notation of [ 16 ] , which is based on the arrival time functions used by [ 32 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，SIPP 问题是隐式图上时间依赖最短路径（TDSP）问题的一个特例，其中只有一个已知的执行时间，并且边成本集合受到限制。 TDSP 模型描述了具有时间依赖边成本的网络。 它们经常应用于道路、通信和其他网络，在这些网络中拥堵程度可能因一天中的不同时间而有所变化。 [ 7 ] 提出了 TDSP 的一个离散时间版本，并附带一种用于求解该问题的改进版贝尔曼-福特算法。 [ 12 ] 观察到，迪杰斯特拉算法 [ 11 ] 可以直接应用于此问题。 此外，[ 12 ] 还指出，无需对时间进行离散化，而是可以将每个节点标记为其最早到达时间的上界。 这与 SIPP 算法 [ 33 ] 中使用的状态支配关系以及 [ 12 ] 所描述的一对多算法中的关系完全相同；后者以与 SIPP 适配 A* 算法相同的方式适配了迪杰斯特拉算法。 我们采用了 [ 16 ] 的记法，该记法基于 [ 32 ] 所使用的到达时间函数。

paragraphs.en: The objective is to find the shortest paths from s o s_{o} to all other vertices in V V , for all time t ∈ ℝ t\in\mathbb{R} . The delay d d is a functional that returns the edge specific delay function d ⁡ [ e ] d[e] . We denote the evaluation of this and other functions that return functions with square braces, while functions that return numbers evaluate with parentheses. For example, d ⁡ [ e ] d[e] is the entire delay function for e e while d ​ [ e ] ​ ( t ) d[e](t) is the specific edge duration value when departing at time t t . While the TDSP permits arbitrary delay functions, often d ⁡ [ e ] d[e] is limited to be first-in-first-out (FIFO), which requires that the delay never have a slope less than − 1 -1 , as that would result in a later departure arriving before an earlier departure. It is also common to consider the subset of problems with piecewise linear delay functions.
paragraphs.zh: 目标是为所有时间 t ∈ ℝ，找到从 s o s_{o} 到 V 中所有其他顶点的最短路径。 延迟 d d 是一个函数，返回每条边的特定延迟函数 d ⁡ [ e ] d[e]。 我们用方括号表示此函数以及其他返回函数的评估结果，而返回数值的函数则用圆括号进行评估。 例如，d ⁡ [ e ] d[e] 是 e 的完整延迟函数，而 d ​ [ e ] ​ ( t ) d[e](t) 是在时间 t 出发时的具体边持续时间值。 尽管 TDSP 允许任意的延迟函数，但通常 d ⁡ [ e ] d[e] 会被限制为先进先出（FIFO）模式，这要求延迟的斜率不能小于 − 1 -1，因为那样的话，较晚出发的事物会比较早出发的事物更早到达。 考虑由分段线性延迟函数构成的问题子集也是一种常见做法。

paragraphs.en: Our focus is on the TDSP with time windows on nodes and edges [ 19 , 20 ] . Time windows are similar to the safe intervals defined for SIPP, however, their interpretation has differed when it comes to windows of states. Most recent work is focused on the case where the node windows are ‘parking bans’: such a node can be temporarily closed for parking (waiting), but may still be traversed. [ 20 ] describes a manipulation to their graph that reduces the TDSP with safe intervals on nodes (which [ 20 ] called “no passing-through periods”) to a TDSP with time windows by replacing each node with a pair of nodes connected by a single edge corresponding to the safe interval. We note that the combination of the nodes with no-passing-through periods described by [ 20 ] and the edge functions of [ 19 ] that alternate between a constant duration and infinite duration directly corresponds to SIPP.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究重点是节点和边上都设有时间窗口的 TDSP [ 19 , 20 ]。 时间窗口与 SIPP 中定义的安全区间类似，但在状态窗口方面，它们的解释有所不同。 最近的研究主要集中在节点窗口为“停车禁令”的情况：此类节点可暂时关闭以禁止停车（等待），但仍可被经过。 [ 20 ] 描述了一种对其图的调整方法，该方法通过将每个节点替换为一对由单条边连接的节点（该边对应安全区间），从而将具有节点安全区间（[ 20 ] 称之为“禁止通过时段”）的 TDSP 转化为具有时间窗口的 TDSP。 我们注意到，[ 20 ] 中描述的具有禁止通过时段的节点与 [ 19 ] 中在恒定持续时间和无限持续时间之间交替变化的边函数相结合，直接对应于 SIPP。

paragraphs.en: [ 35 ] provides a dynamic programming algorithm for the problem described by [ 19 ] . [ 32 ] formalize the problem of [ 20 ] and provides algorithms for a variety of extensions and modifications to the problem. [ 16 ] study the complexity of the problems presented by [ 32 ] . [ 14 ] give an A* algorithm for the TDSP with time windows. Modern work on TDSP has focused on rapidly answering queries in logistics domains, for instance, trucking with driving bans [ 43 , 45 ] and railway scheduling [ 18 ] . paragraphs.en: With these ingredients in hand, in this section we describe Augmented SIPP, a generalization of the SIPP algorithm that returns a plan ATF along with the plan normally returned by SIPP. Augmented SIPP is the inner loop of RePEAT, our algorithm for any-start-time planning. However, it is also useful in its own right, as it provides more information than a standard SIPP search, such as when the plan will no longer be safe, and it illustrates how heuristic search can work with g g values that are functions.
paragraphs.zh: 有了这些要素，我们将在本节中介绍增强型 SIPP（Augmented SIPP），它是 SIPP 算法的一种扩展，能够同时返回一个 ATF 计划以及 SIPP 通常返回的计划。 增强型 SIPP 是我们用于任意起始时间规划算法 RePEAT 的内层循环。 然而，它本身也很有用，因为它比标准的 SIPP 搜索提供了更多信息，例如计划何时将不再安全，并展示了启发式搜索如何与作为函数的 g g 值协同工作。

sents.zh: 有了这些要素，我们将在本节中介绍增强型 SIPP（Augmented SIPP），它是 SIPP 算法的一种扩展，能够同时返回一个 ATF 计划以及 SIPP 通常返回的计划。

sents.en: Augmented SIPP is the inner loop of RePEAT, our algorithm for any-start-time planning.
sents.zh: 增强型 SIPP 是我们用于任意起始时间规划算法 RePEAT 的内层循环。

sents.en: However, it is also useful in its own right, as it provides more information than a standard SIPP search, such as when the plan will no longer be safe, and it illustrates how heuristic search can work with g g values that are functions.
sents.zh: 然而，它本身也很有用，因为它比标准的 SIPP 搜索提供了更多信息，例如计划何时将不再安全，并展示了启发式搜索如何与作为函数的 g g 值协同工作。

paragraphs.en: Because it is built on the SIPP dominance relation (Theorem 1 ), a SIPP search results in a plan where the agent departs as early as possible from each intermediate state. For example, if we imagine our delivery robot, it would be tailgating other cars and crossing the train tracks the moment the train clears. While this is one earliest arriving plan, it is not necessarily uniquely optimal. If the agent will have to wait for a traffic light after the train crossing anyway, there is no difference in arrival time between waiting before crossing the tracks or after. In general, the sequence of actions taken by a SIPP plan is valid, or possibly even optimal, for more than just the single departure time that was planned for. Augmented SIPP captures the whole family of related plans that have different departure times but pass through the same set of states and vary only in when the agent waits and for how long. We do this by augmenting the SIPP search to use a plan ATF g g -value, rather than the usual scalar g g .
paragraphs.zh: 由于该算法建立在 SIPP 支配关系（定理 1）之上，因此 SIPP 搜索会生成一个计划，使得智能体在每个中间状态尽可能早地出发。 例如，假设我们考虑配送机器人，它会在火车驶离轨道的瞬间紧跟其他车辆并穿过铁轨。 虽然这是最早到达的计划之一，但它未必是唯一的最优解。 如果智能体无论如何都必须在通过火车道口后等待交通信号灯，那么在通过道口前或通过后等待，其到达时间并无差异。 总体而言，SIPP 计划所采取的动作序列不仅对原定出发时间有效，甚至可能对其他出发时间也有效或最优。 增强型 SIPP 涵盖了所有相关计划的完整集合：这些计划虽然出发时间不同，但会经过相同的状态集，唯一的区别在于智能体何时以及等待多久。 为此，我们对 SIPP 搜索进行了增强，使其使用计划 ATF g g -值，而非通常使用的标量 g g 。

paragraphs.en: We begin by showing how to create an Augmented SIPP graph for a SIPP problem, this operation is the compilation from a SIPP problem (with safe intervals) to a TDSP problem (with ATFs). The Augmented SIPP graph is identical to the SIPP problem except that, for each edge, we compute an associated edge ATF based on the three safe intervals of 1) the edge, 2) its source state, and 3) its destination state. If desired, the edge ATFs can just as easily be computed lazily as required by an implicit search. We then show how to accumulate costs by calculating plan ATFs in the Augmented SIPP graph as the composition of the ATFs of the edges in the plan. We then give the algorithm for Augmented SIPP, and show that it is complete, optimal, and optimally efficient because it is a type of Cost-algebraic A* 3 3 3 If the safe intervals are inexact, (e.g., an irregular obstacle modeled by a bounding circle) SIPP may become incomplete with regard to the real problem being modeled. .
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先展示如何为 SIPP 问题创建一个增强型 SIPP 图，该操作是将一个 SIPP 问题（包含安全区间）编译为一个 TDSP 问题（包含 ATF）。 增强型 SIPP 图与原始 SIPP 问题完全相同，不同之处在于：对于每条边，我们都会根据以下三个安全区间计算一个相关的边 ATF：1) 该边本身、2) 其源状态以及 3) 其目标状态。 如果需要，这些边 ATF 也可以像隐式搜索所要求的那样，按需延迟计算。 接着，我们展示如何通过计算增强型 SIPP 图中的规划 ATF 来累积成本，其中规划 ATF 是规划中各边 ATF 的组合。 然后，我们给出增强型 SIPP 的算法，并证明该算法是完备的、最优的且具有最优效率，因为它属于一种成本代数 A* 算法。3 3 3 如果安全区间不精确（例如，由边界圆建模的不规则障碍物），SIPP 在模拟的实际问题上可能变得不完备。

sents.zh: 我们首先展示如何为 SIPP 问题创建一个增强型 SIPP 图，该操作是将一个 SIPP 问题（包含安全区间）编译为一个 TDSP 问题（包含 ATF）。

sents.en: The Augmented SIPP graph is identical to the SIPP problem except that, for each edge, we compute an associated edge ATF based on the three safe intervals of 1) the edge, 2) its source state, and 3) its destination state.
sents.zh: 增强型 SIPP 图与原始 SIPP 问题完全相同，不同之处在于：对于每条边，我们都会根据以下三个安全区间计算一个相关的边 ATF：1) 该边本身、2) 其源状态以及 3) 其目标状态。

sents.en: If desired, the edge ATFs can just as easily be computed lazily as required by an implicit search.
sents.zh: 如果需要，这些边 ATF 也可以像隐式搜索所要求的那样，按需延迟计算。

sents.en: We then show how to accumulate costs by calculating plan ATFs in the Augmented SIPP graph as the composition of the ATFs of the edges in the plan.
sents.zh: 接着，我们展示如何通过计算增强型 SIPP 图中的规划 ATF 来累积成本，其中规划 ATF 是规划中各边 ATF 的组合。

sents.en: We then give the algorithm for Augmented SIPP, and show that it is complete, optimal, and optimally efficient because it is a type of Cost-algebraic A* 3 3 3 If the safe intervals are inexact, (e.g., an irregular obstacle modeled by a bounding circle) SIPP may become incomplete with regard to the real problem being modeled. .
sents.zh: 然后，我们给出增强型 SIPP 的算法，并证明该算法是完备的、最优的且具有最优效率，因为它属于一种成本代数 A* 算法。3 3 3 如果安全区间不精确（例如，由边界圆建模的不规则障碍物），SIPP 在模拟的实际问题上可能变得不完备。

paragraphs.en: For a single edge, all waiting must be done prior to taking the action to traverse the edge. However, for a multistep plan, the agent can sometimes be required to wait at intermediate points. While it cannot be forced to wait for longer than the edge is safe, it can be forced to wait along an entire plan for longer than it can wait prior to traversing the first edge. Formally, this means that while α < β \alpha<\beta is true for all edge ATFs individually, it need not be true for a plan ATF.
paragraphs.zh: 对于单条边，所有等待必须在执行穿越该边的动作之前完成。 然而，对于多步骤计划，智能体有时可能需要在中间点等待。 虽然不能强制其等待的时间超过该边安全允许的时间，但可以强制其在整个计划中等待的时间长于它在穿越第一条边前所能等待的时间。 从形式上讲，这意味着尽管对于每条边的 ATF 而言 α < β \alpha<\beta 都成立，但对于一个计划 ATF 而言，这一条件未必成立。

paragraphs.en: We now present Augmented SIPP, an algorithm that solves SIPP while also returning a plan ATF along with the resulting plan. Augmented SIPP is a type of cost-algebraic heuristic search where edge costs are edge ATFs, plan costs (e.g. g g , h h , and f f ) are plan ATFs, and cost accumulates through ATF composition. In SIPP the f f value of a search node is g g the earliest arrival time (along the plan represented by the node) + h h the heuristic time to reach the goal. Augmented SIPP, using the same tie-breaking and h h as SIPP, will select the same node as SIPP for every expansion, in effect conducting an identical search that keeps ATF g g -values rather than scalar g g -values. This is because they both select the next node to expand based on an identical criteria: earliest arrival time starting at t 0 t_{0} . (In the following subsection, we will, after some background on cost-algebraic heuristic search, formalize this similarity by describing Augmented SIPP as a cost-algebraic A*.)
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在介绍增强型 SIPP（Augmented SIPP），这是一种在解决 SIPP 的同时，还能返回 ATF 计划及最终计划的算法。 增强型 SIPP 是一种成本代数启发式搜索，其中边的成本为边 ATF，计划成本（例如 g g、h h 和 f f）为计划 ATF，而成本通过 ATF 组合进行累加。 在 SIPP 中，搜索节点的 f f 值等于 g g（即沿该节点所表示计划的最早到达时间）加上 h h（即到达目标的启发式时间）。 增强型 SIPP 与 SIPP 使用相同的破平规则和 h h，因此在每次扩展时都会选择与 SIPP 相同的节点，实际上执行了完全相同的搜索，只是保留了 ATF g g 值而非标量 g g 值。 这是因为两者都基于相同的标准来选择下一个要扩展的节点：从 t 0 t_{0} 开始的最早到达时间。 （在接下来的子节中，在介绍成本代数启发式搜索的一些背景知识后，我们将通过把增强型 SIPP 描述为一种成本代数 A* 算法，来正式化这种相似性。）

paragraphs.en: In this section, we explore the theoretical properties of Augmented SIPP. We begin by observing that, when using the same ordering, Augmented SIPP is SIPP, and retains all of the same theoretical properties SIPP enjoys as an A* search such as completeness, optimality, and cost-optimality [ 8 ] .

paragraphs.en: In the remainder of this section, we start by formalizing Observation 2 , then we focus on showing that these same properties hold even when we are searching with orderings that are impossible for a regular SIPP search. Many of these arise from Augmented SIPP being a form of cost-algebraic A*, so we will restate the definitions of cost-algebraic heuristic search from [ 13 ] and [ 24 ] , and then show that Augmented SIPP is a cost-algebraic A*. There will be a moment of dramatic tension when we see that the secondary ordering that we want to use for Augmented SIPP does not obey the SIPP dominance relation (Theorem 1 ), but we will resolve this by showing that this problematic secondary sort can be viewed as a tie-breaking strategy for a well-behaved sort, and therefore the search remains complete, admissible, and optimally efficient. Our findings demonstrate a nuanced point: for a cost-algebraic heuristic search, it is not always correct to prune successors using the same total ordering as is used to order the open list!
paragraphs.zh: 在本节的剩余部分中，我们首先对观察 2 进行形式化表述，然后重点证明：即使使用常规 SIPP 搜索无法处理的排序进行搜索，这些特性依然成立。 其中许多特性源于增强型 SIPP 是成本代数 A* 的一种形式，因此我们将重新阐述 [13] 和 [24] 中关于成本代数启发式搜索的定义，并随后证明增强型 SIPP 属于成本代数 A*。 当我们发现希望用于增强型 SIPP 的次要排序并不满足 SIPP 支配关系（定理 1）时，会出现一个充满戏剧性张力的时刻；但我们将通过证明：这种存在问题的次要排序可被视为一种为行为良好的排序设计的决胜策略，从而确保搜索仍然保持完备性、可接受性和最优效率。 我们的研究结果揭示了一个微妙的问题：对于成本代数启发式搜索而言，使用与开放列表排序相同的完全序来剪枝后继节点，并非总是正确的！

sents.en: In the remainder of this section, we start by formalizing Observation 2 , then we focus on showing that these same properties hold even when we are searching with orderings that are impossible for a regular SIPP search.

sents.en: Many of these arise from Augmented SIPP being a form of cost-algebraic A*, so we will restate the definitions of cost-algebraic heuristic search from [ 13 ] and [ 24 ] , and then show that Augmented SIPP is a cost-algebraic A*.

paragraphs.en: In fact, when substituting Augmented SIPP in for SIPP, it is possible to run a regular SIPP search, and then compute the ATF of only the actual returned plan while that plan is being backed up from the goal node. However, we have described a full search with ATFs because in any-start-time planning we will use a node ordering that is not possible to use with SIPP (because it requires the ATFs during search) in addition to making use of the ATF of the eventually found plan.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上，当用增强型 SIPP 替代 SIPP 时，可以执行一次常规的 SIPP 搜索，然后在从目标节点回溯该计划的过程中，仅计算实际返回计划的 ATF。 然而，我们描述了包含 ATF 的完整搜索，因为在任何开始时间的规划中，我们将使用一种在 SIPP 中无法使用的节点排序（因为 SIPP 在搜索过程中不需要 ATF），此外还会利用最终找到的计划的 ATF。

paragraphs.en: However, it is more informative to derive these properties of Augmented SIPP by examining it as an instance of a cost-algebraic A* [ 13 ] . This description demonstrates that the correctness and optimality of Augmented SIPP arise from using ATFs as edge costs and the composition operation that accumulates those costs along a plan. Additionally, the claim of Observation 2 does not apply when we use Augmented SIPP with a tie-breaking strategy that is not possible to do with SIPP alone, which is exactly what we will do when using it for any-start-time planning. Thus, it is useful to understand that the theoretical guarantees of Augmented SIPP do not have to rely on its relationship to conventional SIPP search.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，通过将增强型 SIPP 视为成本代数 A* 的一个实例 [13] 来推导其属性，会更具信息量。 这一描述表明，增强型 SIPP 的正确性和最优性源于使用 ATF 作为边成本，以及沿规划路径累加这些成本的组合操作。 此外，当我们将增强型 SIPP 与一种仅靠 SIPP 无法实现的破平策略结合使用时，观察 2 的论断便不再适用——而这正是我们在任何起始时间规划中使用它时的做法。 因此，理解增强型 SIPP 的理论保证并不必然依赖于它与传统 SIPP 搜索的关系，这一点很有帮助。

paragraphs.en: Pruning a cost-algebraic search using its total ordering ( ⪯ \preceq ) does not prune all optimal plans.
paragraphs.zh: 使用总序关系（⪯ \preceq）对成本代数搜索进行剪枝时，并不会剪除所有最优规划。

paragraphs.en: This follows in a straightforward manner from isotonicity. Consider two nodes, a a and b b , both representing plans up to some shared state s s . Because a ⪯ b a\preceq b , we prune b b . Suppose we did not prune b b . The costs of plans for every successor c c of b b and a a are a × c a\times c or b × c b\times c , respectively, for the plans via a a or b b . By isotonicity, a × c ⪯ b × c a\times c\preceq b\times c , and the same follows inductively for all pairs of plans, which share the same subplan after a a and b b . Therefore, it is safe to have pruned b b because if there were an optimal plan through node b b , there must also be one through a a that was not pruned. ∎

paragraphs.en: We now show that Augmented SIPP, with the usual SIPP search orderings, is a Cost-algebraic A*. paragraphs.en: The optimality and correctness of Augmented SIPP do not rely on it being identical to the SIPP algorithm. Instead, it is a property of searching with ATFs.
paragraphs.zh: Augmented SIPP 的最优性和正确性并不依赖于它与 SIPP 算法完全相同。 相反，这是使用 ATF 进行搜索所具有的特性。

sents.en: Instead, it is a property of searching with ATFs.
sents.zh: 相反，这是使用 ATF 进行搜索所具有的特性。

paragraphs.en: So far, we have shown that Augmented SIPP with isotone node ordering ( ≤ ↓ f \leq_{\downarrow f} , ≤ ↓ f ↑ g \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow g} ) behaves as expected. We now examine the properties of Augmented SIPP when using other search orderings ≤ ↓ f ↑ α \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha} or ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} that we will use below in our approach to any-start-time planning. First, we will demonstrate that this ordering is not isotone and that it violates the SIPP dominance relationship (Theorem 1 ). Then, we show how to modify the pruning done by Augmented SIPP to avoid these issues. In short, we can only prune nodes when their ATF is dominated, a weaker partial order than the total order used to order 𝑜𝑝𝑒𝑛 \mathit{open} .
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经证明，采用等音调节点排序（≤ ↓ f \leq_{\downarrow f}、≤ ↓ f ↑ g \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow g}）的增强型 SIPP 能够按预期运行。 接下来，我们将研究当使用其他搜索排序 ≤ ↓ f ↑ α \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha} 或 ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} 时增强型 SIPP 的特性，这些排序将在下文用于我们的任意起始时间规划方法中。 首先，我们将证明这种排序并非等音调的，并且它违反了 SIPP 支配关系（定理 1）。 然后，我们将展示如何修改增强型 SIPP 所执行的剪枝操作，以避免这些问题。 简而言之，我们只能在节点的 ATF 被支配时对其进行剪枝，而支配是一种比用于排序 𝑜𝑝𝑒𝑛 \mathit{open} 的全序更弱的偏序。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows an example Augmented SIPP problem that demonstrates that the Augmented SIPP monoid with ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} is not isotone through a violation of the SIPP dominance relationship. The graph shown in Figure 7(a) consists of three states: S 1 S_{1} , S 2 S_{2} , and S 3 S_{3} . For simplicity we have h ⁡ [ n ] = I ⁡ [ 0 , 0 ] h[n]=I[0,0] which is equivalent to the scalar heuristic h ⁡ ( n ) = 0 h(n)=0 . The starting state is S 1 S_{1} and the goal state is S 3 S_{3} . There are two edges connecting S 1 S_{1} to S 2 S_{2} ; the ATFs of these two paths are shown in Figure 7(b) . Edge a a arrives at S 2 S_{2} earlier (i.e., visually in Figure 7(b) it has a lower f ⁡ ( n ) = h ⁡ [ n ] ∘ g ⁡ [ n ] = g ⁡ [ n ] f(n)=h[n]\circ g[n]=g[n] shown as t 𝑎𝑟𝑟 t_{\mathit{arr}} in Figure 7 ), however the plan is invalid earlier (i.e.,it has an earlier β \beta ). On the other hand, the other edge b b from S 1 S_{1} arrives at S 2 S_{2} later but with a plan that is valid for longer. Because it has a higher g ⁡ ( n ) g(n) , Augmented SIPP with ordering and pruning using ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} would prune b b in favor of a a (Algorithm 2 , Line 17 ). However, if we were to keep it and extend these two paths by the edge c c we see that c c introduces a stricter constraint (in the form of a high α \alpha ) than either a a or b b , erasing their difference in terms of earliest arrival time but leaving the plan using b b better because it remains valid longer. This contradicts the SIPP dominance relation (Theorem 1 ): the node ( a a ) that arrives earlier at S 2 S_{2} is worse, because though both have the same earliest arrival time at the goal, the plan using b b stays optimal for longer, and then stays executable for longer. In fact, the ATF of b ​ c bc dominates the ATF of a ​ c ac , so it would actually be correct to prune a ​ c ac (if the search were to continue to a goal past S 3 S_{3} ). More precisely, the reason that the Augmented SIPP monoid is anisotonic with respect to the total ordering ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} is because our ordering is trying to maximize β ⁡ ( n ) \beta(n) , a value that is successively minimized by the ATF composition operation (Equation 16 ) along a path.

paragraphs.en: This result is perhaps counterintuitive, as we would not generally expect a tie-breaking strategy (here ↑ α ↑ β \uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta ) to require a weakening of the pruning rules. In summary, ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} can be viewed as a tie-breaking strategy for ≤ ↓ f \leq_{\downarrow f} ; in this view, we can prune using ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} , but we are only guaranteed to find a least f f solution (not a greatest β \beta , greatest α \alpha , least f f solution). This illustrates that not all optimizations that are correct when used with A* (e.g., pruning using the same ordering as the search) can also be used with all other variants of cost-algebraic A*.
paragraphs.zh: 这个结果或许与直觉相反，因为我们通常不会期望一种打破平局的策略（此处为 ↑ α ↑ β \uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta ）需要削弱剪枝规则。 总而言之，≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} 可以被视为 ≤ ↓ f \leq_{\downarrow f} 的一种打破平局的策略；从这一角度来看，我们可以使用 ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} 进行剪枝，但我们只能保证找到一个最小的 f f 解（而非最大的 β \beta 、最大的 α \alpha 或最小的 f f 解）。 这表明，并非所有在与 A* 配合使用时正确的优化方法（例如，使用与搜索相同的顺序进行剪枝）都能同样适用于成本代数 A* 的所有其他变体。

paragraphs.en: In order to guarantee that the found plan respects the full ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} ordering, we weaken the pruning used by Augmented SIPP, so that we no longer prune non-dominated nodes. This is making a tradeoff to do less pruning in the initial Augmented SIPP search so that the solution it finds is more informative, which leads to fewer Augmented SIPP searches needing to be run to find the any-start-time plan. When we potentially devote extra (beyond using ≤ ↓ f ↑ g \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow g} ) expansions, we are eliminating those expansions from later rounds of any-start-time search.
paragraphs.zh: 为了确保找到的计划完全遵循 ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} 排序，我们放宽了增强 SIPP 所使用的剪枝策略，因此不再剪枝非支配节点。 这样做是在初始的增强 SIPP 搜索中减少剪枝，以换取更丰富的解决方案信息，从而在找到任意起始时间计划时，需要运行的增强 SIPP 搜索次数更少。 当我们可能投入额外的（超出使用 ≤ ↓ f ↑ g \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow g} 的）展开操作时，我们会将这些展开从后续任何起始时间的搜索轮次中排除。

paragraphs.en: We will use aSIPP αβ to refer to the instantiation of Augmented SIPP where we:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将使用 aSIPP αβ 来指代增强型 SIPP 的实例，其中我们：

paragraphs.en: select nodes from 𝑜𝑝𝑒𝑛 \mathit{open} based on the total ordering ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} , and
paragraphs.zh: 根据全序关系 ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} 从 𝑜𝑝𝑒𝑛 \mathit{open} 中选择节点，并且

paragraphs.en: prune generated nodes representing the same state as a previously-generated node based on the partial ordering ⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF} .
paragraphs.zh: 根据偏序关系 ⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF}，剪枝那些与先前生成的节点表示相同状态的生成节点。

paragraphs.en: Note that ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} respects ≤ ↓ f \leq_{\downarrow f} , being merely a tie-breaking strategy among equal f f nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} 尊重 ≤ ↓ f \leq_{\downarrow f}，它仅仅是相等 f f 节点之间的一种打破平局的策略。

paragraphs.en: We now explore the optimality of aSIPP αβ . This hinges on two results: first, that pruning using ⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF} retains optimal plans, and second, that when ordering open by ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} the first goal node expanded is an optimal plan.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在探讨 aSIPP αβ 的最优性。 这取决于两个结果：首先，使用 ⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF} 进行剪枝能够保留最优计划；其次，当按照 ≤ ↓ f ↑ α ↑ β \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow\alpha\uparrow\beta} 对开放节点排序时，第一个被展开的目标节点就是一个最优计划。

paragraphs.en: Pruning aSIPP αβ using ⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF} does not prune all optimal plans.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 ⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF} 对 aSIPP αβ 进行剪枝并不会剪掉所有最优规划。

paragraphs.en: Observe that ⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF} is isotonic. If, for two nodes a a and b b to their shared state s s , a ​ ⊴ A ​ T ​ F ​ b a\trianglelefteq_{ATF}b , then the plan for a a arrives at least as early in s s as the plan for b b for all possible arrival times, so it will be at least as good as b b for any continuing plans, so it is safe to prune b b . ∎
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF} 是单调递增的。 如果对于两个节点 a a 和 b b 及其共享状态 s s ，有 a ​ ⊴ A ​ T ​ F ​ b a\trianglelefteq_{ATF}b ，那么在所有可能的到达时间下，a a 的计划在 s s 中的到达时间至少不早于 b b 的计划，因此对于任何后续计划，其效果至少与 b b 一样好，所以可以安全地剪枝 b b 。 ∎

sents.en: Observe that ⊴ A ​ T ​ F \trianglelefteq_{ATF} is isotonic.

paragraphs.en: Augmented SIPP finds a solution that is optimal for at least one (of infinitely many) departure times, which is the starting time of the search t 0 = 0 t_{0}=0 . Clearly, a solution is optimal at least until its α \alpha breakpoint (assuming α ≤ β \alpha\leq\beta ) because the arrival time remains constant, and any plan that arrives earlier would have had a lower f f than our original solution, meaning it would have been returned instead. However, if we pause the Augmented SIPP search at the moment a goal state (call its node 𝑠𝑜𝑙𝑛 \mathit{soln} ) is selected for expansion and examine the optimal f f -layer (the set of nodes n ∈ open n\in\textit{open} with f ⁡ ( n ) = f ⁡ ( soln ) f(n)=f(\textit{soln}) ), we may find a variety of plans with a variety of ATFs, all with the same f f (perhaps optimistic due to an admissible h h ). However with aSIPP αβ the returned solution dominates its entire f f -layer, meaning that aSIPP αβ returns a solution that is optimal until another solution with a later arrival time:

paragraphs.en: Solutions found with this ordering dominate those found with the typical ≤ ↓ f ↑ g \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow g} ordering. Crucially, the solution ATF also enables us to reason about how long the solution is optimal, given the rest of the open list when the search completes. Informally, Theorem 18 shows our solution dominates others in its f-layer, so our solution is optimal until its β \beta , or until its ATF intersects with another (higher f) node’s ATF, which can only happen on the rising segment, in the interval ( α , β ) (\alpha,\beta) . The details of this are explored in subsection 5.4 . But, because the Augmented SIPP solution dominates its entire f-layer, it is guaranteed to be optimal for a strictly positive duration, in both departure time and arrival time. Which is to say, it is guaranteed to make progress in constructing an any-start-time plan.
paragraphs.zh: 通过这种排序找到的解优于采用典型 ≤ ↓ f ↑ g \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow g} 排序时找到的解。 关键在于，该解的 ATF 还使我们能够分析，在搜索结束时，考虑到开放列表中的其余节点，该解的最优持续时间有多长。 非正式地说，定理 18 表明我们的解在其 f-层中优于其他解，因此我们的解在其 β \beta 之前都是最优的，或者直到其 ATF 与另一个（f 值更高）节点的 ATF 相交，而这种情况只可能发生在上升段，即区间 ( α , β ) (\alpha,\beta) 内。 相关细节将在第 5.4 小节中探讨。 但是，由于增强型 SIPP 解在其整个 f-层中都占主导地位，因此可以确保它在出发时间和到达时间上都能保持严格正的最优持续时间。 也就是说，它保证能够推进任何起始时间的计划构建过程。

sents.en: Informally, Theorem 18 shows our solution dominates others in its f-layer, so our solution is optimal until its β \beta , or until its ATF intersects with another (higher f) node’s ATF, which can only happen on the rising segment, in the interval ( α , β ) (\alpha,\beta) .

sents.en: The details of this are explored in subsection 5.4 .

sents.en: But, because the Augmented SIPP solution dominates its entire f-layer, it is guaranteed to be optimal for a strictly positive duration, in both departure time and arrival time.
sents.zh: 但是，由于增强型 SIPP 解在其整个 f-层中都占主导地位，因此可以确保它在出发时间和到达时间上都能保持严格正的最优持续时间。

sents.en: Which is to say, it is guaranteed to make progress in constructing an any-start-time plan.
sents.zh: 也就是说，它保证能够推进任何起始时间的计划构建过程。

paragraphs.en: Now that we have an understanding of planning with ATFs using Augmented SIPP, we can turn our focus back to the central problem of this paper: any-start-time planning.

paragraphs.en: In brief: to solve @SIPP, we will repeatedly run aSIPP αβ with a monotonically increasing starting time, storing the resulting ATFs in a compound ATF (cATF). The cATF can be efficiently queried for a plan at any start time. The final piece to solving @SIPP is knowing for what start times to call aSIPP αβ . We show how to compute a monotonically increasing ‘reference time’ that tracks the time up to which, based on the current set of aSIPP αβ results, the @SIPP plan is provably optimal. Together, these form an anytime algorithm that we call RePEAT, in part because it repeatedly computes optimal plans for later and later reference times.
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之：为了解决 @SIPP，我们将重复运行 aSIPP αβ，其起始时间单调递增，并将得到的 ATF 存储在一个复合 ATF（cATF）中。 可以高效地通过 cATF 查询任意起始时间的计划。 解决 @SIPP 的最后一个环节是确定在哪些起始时间调用 aSIPP αβ。 我们将展示如何计算一个单调递增的“参考时间”，该时间用于追踪：基于当前 aSIPP αβ 的结果集，在此时间之前，@SIPP 计划被证明是最优的。 这些方法共同构成了一种我们称之为 RePEAT 的随时可用算法，部分原因是它会为越来越晚的参考时间重复计算最优计划。

paragraphs.en: We describe an algorithm for solving @SIPP, called RePEAT (because it is Repeatedly Planning for Ever-Ascending Times). It works by repeatedly calling aSIPP αβ with a monotonically increasing starting time. The result is a set of plans that contains the optimal plan for any start time. (In contrast, the objective of Augmented SIPP was to find a single plan that is optimal for a specified starting time.) Although @SIPP is defined as an offline problem, one way of thinking about RePEAT is as an anytime algorithm: the longer it runs, the further into the future we have optimal plans in our any-start-time plan. Assuming it can progress the reference time at least as fast as time passes, RePEAT will always have an optimal solution when signaled to act. The example in Section 5.1 followed the form of RePEAT, however in this section we describe RePEAT in detail, particularly how a compound ATF can be represented efficiently and how to calculate the time until which an aSIPP αβ plan is optimal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们描述了一种用于解决 @SIPP 的算法，名为 RePEAT（因为它代表“无限次重复规划”）。 它通过反复调用 aSIPP αβ，并每次使用单调递增的起始时间来运行。 其结果是一个计划集合，其中包含了任何起始时间下的最优计划。 （相比之下，Augmented SIPP 的目标是找到一个在指定起始时间下最优的单一路径。）尽管 @SIPP 被定义为一个离线问题，但 RePEAT 也可以被理解为一个“随时可用”的算法：运行时间越长，我们的“任意起始时间计划”中所能覆盖的未来最优计划就越远。 假设参考时间的推进速度至少与真实时间的流逝速度相当，那么当接收到行动指令时，RePEAT 总能给出一个最优解。 第 5.1 节中的示例遵循了 RePEAT 的形式，但本节我们将详细阐述 RePEAT，特别是如何高效表示复合 ATF，以及如何计算 aSIPP αβ 计划保持最优的时间范围。

paragraphs.en: In the following subsections, we detail the two key operations for RePEAT beyond aSIPP αβ : how the cATF is efficiently implemented and how the reference time is updated. paragraphs.en: The edge and plan ATFs used by Augmented SIPP have a straightforward representation consisting of the four real-valued parameters ζ , α , β , and ​ Δ \zeta,\alpha,\beta,\text{ and }\Delta . As we have seen in our examples, the optimal plan may be different for different starting times, so compound ATFs represent the arrival time function of a set of plans. Formally, consider a set of plans ℙ ⊆ E N \mathbb{P}\subseteq E^{N} and denote the search node associated with a specific plan as p ∈ ℙ p\in\mathbb{P} . Each plan has an associated plan ATF ( A ⁡ [ p ] A[p] ), and a cATF is the ATF of the entire set of plans. In the context of any-start-time planning, we are finding the cATF of plans between the start and goal states, which we denote by A ⁡ [ s , d ] : s , d ∈ S A[s,d]:s,d\in S . paragraphs.en: We will use cATF to refer both to the set of plans ℙ \mathbb{P} and its associated ATF A ⁡ [ ℙ ] A[\mathbb{P}] . While it would be trivial to implement a cATF as a simple set of plans, if we do not track when each plan is optimal, then we would need to try all of the plans each time we use the cATF to compute an arrival time, potentially slowing down our search. paragraphs.en: We represent a cATF as an ordered mapping of time intervals to plans ( I ↦ ℙ I\mapsto\mathbb{P} ). Recall that each plan p ∈ ℙ p\in\mathbb{P} has an ATF A ⁡ [ p ] A[p] of the general form shown in Figure 10 , consisting of up to two segments: the flat segment with interval [ ζ , min ⁡ ( α , β ) ) [\zeta,\min(\alpha,\beta)) , and if α < β \alpha<\beta the rising segment with interval [ α , β ) [\alpha,\beta) . Each interval in a cATF maps to a search node, so that the plan and its ATF corresponding to times in that interval can be quickly retrieved. These intervals capture when each plan in the cATF is optimal, and allow for the quick retrieval of those plans. The reason that each plan is not represented by a single interval is that an ATF might be optimal for several disjoint intervals of departure time; an example of this is shown in Figure 11 .

paragraphs.en: We then separately insert each segment into the compound ATF (Line 8 ). The split interval map breaks the timeline into time intervals, one for each segment, except when an existing ‘incumbent’ segment overlaps the newly added segment. We consider these time-overlapping segments (Line 9 ) and first check if the incumbent (Line 11 ) or the newcomer (Line 13 ) dominates for the entire overlap. In these cases, the dominant one can be retained and the other removed (Lines 12 , 14 ). Otherwise, we are guaranteed that the two line segments intersect, so we calculate the time t t when this intersection occurs (Line 16 ) and replace the two overlapping segments with the appropriate non-overlapping sub-segments (Line 21 ).
paragraphs.zh: 然后，我们将每个片段分别插入到复合 ATF 中（第 8 行）。 分割区间映射将时间线划分为多个时间区间，每个片段对应一个区间，除非现有的“在位”片段与新增的片段存在重叠。 我们考虑这些时间上重叠的片段（第 9 行），首先检查是“在位”片段（第 11 行）还是新加入的片段（第 13 行）在整个重叠区间内占主导地位。 在这些情况下，可以保留占主导地位的片段，并移除另一个片段（第 12、14 行）。 否则，我们保证这两个线段必然相交，因此计算其交点发生的时间 t t（第 16 行），并用适当的非重叠子片段替换这两个重叠的片段（第 21 行）。

sents.en: Otherwise, we are guaranteed that the two line segments intersect, so we calculate the time t t when this intersection occurs (Line 16 ) and replace the two overlapping segments with the appropriate non-overlapping sub-segments (Line 21 ).

paragraphs.en: The time complexity of the insert operation is linear in the number of segments in the overlap (Line 9 ), and logarithmic in the size of the compound ATF due to the binary search to find the extent of the interval, thus the worst case complexity of the compound ATF insertion operation is O ⁡ ( | c | ​ ln ⁡ ( | c | + | p | ) ) O(|c|\ln{(|c|+|p|)}) .
paragraphs.zh: 插入操作的时间复杂度与重叠区域中的分段数量呈线性关系（第 9 行），并且由于需要通过二分查找确定区间的范围，因此与复合 ATF 的大小呈对数关系；由此，复合 ATF 插入操作的 worst case 时间复杂度为 O ⁡ ( | c | ​ ln ⁡ ( | c | + | p | ) ) O(|c|\ln{(|c|+|p|)})。

paragraphs.en: Querying a compound ATF is a straightforward operation: we perform a binary search over the ordered set of time intervals to find the one containing the query time. We then compute the arrival time using the ATF mapped from that interval. The runtime of this operation is O ⁡ ( log ⁡ ( c ) ) O(\log(c)) because of the binary search. We will explore the on-line performance of querying compound ATFs in the empirical evaluation, but we expect this operation to be very fast in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 查询复合 ATF 是一项直接的操作：我们对有序的时间区间集合执行二分搜索，以找到包含查询时间的那个区间。 接着，我们使用从该区间映射出的 ATF 来计算到达时间。 由于采用了二分搜索，该操作的运行时间为 O ⁡ ( log ⁡ ( c ) ) O(\log(c))。 我们将在实证评估中探讨查询复合 ATF 的在线性能，但我们预计该操作在实际应用中会非常快。

paragraphs.en: The operation to compute if an ATF is dominated by another ATF is the same whether those ATFs are plan ATFs or compound ATFs. It is sufficient to consider only the breakpoints of the two ATFs when checking for dominance (Definition 4.9 ), because the ATFS are monotonic non-decreasing, and can only increase discontinuously at breakpoints. Any change in which ATF is dominant (called a minimization breakpoint) is guaranteed to be preceded and followed by breakpoints on the same segments. See Section 6 for a detailed exploration of the theoretical properties of compound ATFs, which is focused on understanding their breakpoints. With this, checking plan domination amounts to iterating through the breakpoints of the two ATFs, and checking if one always arrives at least as early as the other. Because we maintain both ATFs (e.g., A , A ′ A,A^{\prime} ) in order, the runtime is O ⁡ ( | A | + | A ′ | ) O(|A|+|A^{\prime}|) . For a pair of plan ATFs this is O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) , but if there is a compound ATF, in the worst case, we might need to check all of the breakpoints to check dominance.
paragraphs.zh: 判断一个ATF是否被另一个ATF支配的操作，无论这些ATF是计划ATF还是复合ATF，都是相同的。 在检查支配关系时，只需考虑两个ATF的断点即可（定义4.9），因为ATF是单调非递减的，且只能在断点处发生不连续的增加。 任何关于哪个ATF占主导地位的变化（称为最小化断点），都必然由同一分段上的断点前后所伴随。 有关复合ATF理论性质的详细探讨，请参见第6节，该部分重点在于理解其断点。 因此，检查计划支配关系相当于遍历两个ATF的断点，并判断其中一个是否始终至少与另一个同时或更早到达。 由于我们以顺序维护两个ATF（例如，A、A′），时间复杂度为O(|A| + |A′|)。 对于一对计划ATF，该复杂度为O(1)；但如果存在复合ATF，在最坏情况下，可能需要检查所有断点才能确定支配关系。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 5 shows the reference time update. If open is empty (Line 2 ), then no (non-dominated) plan was found by Augmented SIPP, so the new reference time is t 𝑟𝑒𝑓 ′ = ∞ t_{\mathit{ref}}^{\prime}=\infty . Otherwise, the reference time will be in the interval t 𝑟𝑒𝑓 ′ ∈ ( α ⁡ ( 𝑠𝑜𝑙𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 ) , β ⁡ ( 𝑠𝑜𝑙𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 ) ) t_{\mathit{ref}}^{\prime}\in(\alpha(\mathit{solution}),\beta(\mathit{solution})) . We then look at each node n n on open, geometrically we know that the intersection must occur at the intersection of the rising segment of 𝑠𝑜𝑙𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 \mathit{solution} and the flat segment of n n , (two segments with the same slope being unable to intersect, and being constrained to the rising segment of 𝑠𝑜𝑙𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 \mathit{solution} ), so we calculate the (hypothetical) intersection point in departure time as 𝑙𝑜𝑤𝑒𝑟𝐵𝑜𝑢𝑛𝑑 \mathit{lowerBound} (Line 7 ). If the hypothetical intersection is really an intersection (Line 8 ), then we return the departure time of the intersection point as the new reference time. Otherwise, if we find an intersection time that would be after β ⁡ ( 𝑠𝑜𝑙𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 ) \beta(\mathit{solution}) , then we know there will be no intersection and return β ⁡ ( 𝑠𝑜𝑙𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 ) \beta(\mathit{solution}) .
paragraphs.zh: 算法 5 展示了参考时间的更新方法。 如果 open 为空（第 2 行），则 Augmented SIPP 未找到任何（非支配的）计划，因此新的参考时间为 t_{\mathit{ref}}^{\prime}=\infty。 否则，参考时间将位于区间 t_{\mathit{ref}}^{\prime}\in(\alpha(\mathit{solution}),\beta(\mathit{solution})) 内。 接着我们检查 open 中的每个节点 n；从几何角度可知，交点必须出现在 solution 的上升段与 n 的水平段的交点处（两个斜率相同的线段无法相交，且受限于 solution 的上升段），因此我们将（假设的）交点在出发时间上的值计算为 lowerBound（第 7 行）。 如果该假设的交点确实是一个实际交点（第 8 行），则我们返回该交点的出发时间作为新的参考时间。 否则，如果我们发现某个交点时间会晚于 \beta(\mathit{solution})，则说明不存在交点，此时返回 \beta(\mathit{solution})。

sents.zh: 因此，在 t_{\mathit{ref}} 之前，RePEAT 是最优的；并且由于 t_{\mathit{ref}} 是单调递增的，根据归纳法可知，RePEAT 在所有时间都能找到最优解。∎

paragraphs.en: As an alternative to full any-start-time planning, one might consider a simple replanning approach, which we call RSIPP. RSIPP approximates an online solution to @SIPP by using an offline planner at query time. It does no computation ahead of time, but just waits until the start time. It then runs SIPP starting from the current time t n ​ o ​ w t_{now} (Line 5 ). If the found plan is still valid after planning completes, we return it, otherwise we loop back and run SIPP again. If the problem is simple enough and the planner fast enough, this should return a valid plan in time to be used. However, it does not truly solve the @SIPP problem, as we are only returning a single plan.
paragraphs.zh: 作为完全任意开始时间规划的一种替代方案，我们可以考虑一种简单的重新规划方法，我们称之为 RSIPP。 RSIPP 通过在查询时使用离线规划器来近似求解 @SIPP 的在线方案。 它不会提前进行任何计算，而是直接等待直到开始时间到来。 然后，它会从当前时间 t_{now}（第 5 行）开始运行 SIPP。 如果规划完成后找到的计划仍然有效，我们就返回该计划；否则，我们会循环回去并再次运行 SIPP。 如果问题足够简单且规划器足够快，这种方法应该能及时返回一个可用的有效计划。 然而，它并未真正解决 @SIPP 问题，因为我们只返回了一个单一的计划。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we explore the theoretical complexity of any-start-time planning and RePEAT. We start by analyzing the space complexity of any-start-time plans, finding them at most linear in the size of the input graph. Then, in Subsection 6.2 , we prove the time complexity of RePEAT quasi-quadratic in the size of the input graph. (We will experimentally evaluate the runtime of RePEAT on SIPP problems in Section 7 .) These theoretical results highlight the utility of any-start-time planning as the subset of the TDSP where the any-start-time plan is relatively easy to compute.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将探讨任意起始时间规划与 RePEAT 的理论复杂度。 我们首先分析任意起始时间规划的空间复杂度，发现其最多与输入图的大小呈线性关系。 接着，在第 6.2 小节中，我们将证明 RePEAT 的时间复杂度与输入图的大小呈准二次方关系。 （我们将在第 7 节通过实验评估 RePEAT 在 SIPP 问题上的运行时间。）这些理论结果凸显了任意起始时间规划的实用性，因为它是 TDSP 的一个子集，其中任意起始时间规划相对容易计算。

paragraphs.en: In this subsection, we discuss the complexity of the solution to an any-start-time problem. If we are to use cATFs to represent any-start-time plans, the crucial question is how many distinct breakpoints will need to be represented. Can the required number ever grow multiplicatively? We will find that the compound ATF solving an any-start-time problem is linear in the size of the input graph. This is a direct result of any-start-time planning being a special case of the TDSP. We define the size of the input graph to mean the number of safe intervals on states and actions. In an infinite state space, this is the size of the local search space that encompasses all states explored by any of the implicit Augmented SIPP searches.
paragraphs.zh: 在本小节中，我们将讨论任意开始时间问题的解的复杂性。 如果我们使用 cATF 来表示任意开始时间计划，关键问题是需要表示多少个不同的断点。 所需的数量是否可能以乘法方式增长？ 我们会发现，解决任意开始时间问题的复合 ATF 与输入图的大小呈线性关系。 这是任意开始时间规划作为 TDSP 特例的直接结果。 我们将输入图的大小定义为状态和行动上的安全区间数量。 在无限状态空间中，这指的是局部搜索空间的大小，该空间涵盖了任何隐式增强 SIPP 搜索所探索的所有状态。

paragraphs.en: [ 16 ] find that a TDSP with piecewise linear edge durations has a super-polynomial solution complexity. However, when the edge ATFs consist of segments with slopes constrained to 0 , 1 0,1 , or ∞ \infty , the solution is linear in the size of the graph. This complexity was also proved by [ 9 ] , who explored a similar setting where the objective is to find the time-dependent shortest path to all other states. In this section, we adapt the proof to the specific context of any-start-time planning and then describe a simple compilation from an any-start-time planning problem to a time-dependent shortest path problem. The space of these compiled any-start-time problems is exactly the set of TDSP problems [ 16 ] found to be linear.
paragraphs.zh: [ 16 ] 发现，具有分段线性边持续时间的 TDSP 具有超多项式解法复杂度。 然而，当边的 ATF 由斜率限制为 0、1/0,1 或 ∞ \infty 的线段组成时，其解法复杂度与图的大小呈线性关系。 [ 9 ] 也证明了这种复杂度，他们研究了一个类似场景，其目标是找到通往所有其他状态的时间依赖最短路径。 在本节中，我们将该证明方法调整到任意开始时间规划的具体情境中，然后描述如何将任意开始时间规划问题转换为一个时间依赖最短路径问题。 这些经过转换的任意开始时间问题的空间，恰好是 [ 16 ] 发现具有线性复杂度的 TDSP 问题集合。

paragraphs.en: The proof relies on counting the breakpoints in the resulting piecewise linear cATF. We begin by more precisely defining plans and the features of their ATFs. An Augmented SIPP plan p p is an interleaved ordered sequence of states and edges s 0 , e 1 , s 1 , … , e i , s i , … , e n , s n s_{0},e_{1},s_{1},...,e_{i},s_{i},...,e_{n},s_{n} with e ∈ E e\in E and s ∈ S s\in S . Note that in this scheme the sequence of states uses zero-based indexing, while the sequence of edges uses one-based indexing. For notational simplicity, we often choose to drop one of the components of a plan. For example, we often only consider the edges of a plan p p , which we will denote by e 1 , … , e n ∈ p e_{1},...,e_{n}\in p , as the safety information of the states has been compiled into the edge ATFs. A plan p p is valid at time t t if and only if, for all edges e i e_{i} of the plan, s i − 1 s_{i-1} is the source of e i e_{i} and s i s_{i} is the destination of e i e_{i} and the plan ATF evaluated at time t t is finite ( A ​ [ p ] ​ ( t ) ∈ ℝ A[p](t)\in\mathbb{R} ). A partial plan p i , j := s i − 1 , e i , s i , … , e j , s j ∈ p p_{i,j}:=s_{i-1},e_{i},s_{i},...,e_{j},s_{j}\in p is a subsequence of the full plan p p and e i ∈ p e_{i}\in p denotes the i i th edge of p p (counting from e 1 e_{1} ), and s i ∈ p s_{i}\in p denotes the i i th state (counting from s 0 s_{0} ) .
paragraphs.zh: 该证明依赖于对所得分段线性 cATF 中断点数量的计算。 我们首先更精确地定义计划及其 ATF 的特征。 一个增强型 SIPP 计划 p p 是一个交错有序的状态与边序列：s 0 , e 1 , s 1 , … , e i , s i , … , e n , s n s_{0},e_{1},s_{1},...,e_{i},s_{i},...,e_{n},s_{n}，其中 e ∈ E e\in E 且 s ∈ S s\in S 。 请注意，在此方案中，状态序列使用从零开始的索引，而边序列则使用从一开始的索引。 为简化表示，我们通常会省略计划中的一个组成部分。 例如，我们通常只考虑计划 p p 中的边，记作 e 1 , … , e n ∈ p e_{1},...,e_{n}\in p ，因为状态的安全信息已被整合到边的 ATF 中。 一个计划 p p 在时间 t t 有效当且仅当：对于该计划的所有边 e i e_{i}，s i − 1 s_{i-1} 是 e i e_{i} 的源点，s i s_{i} 是 e i e_{i} 的终点，并且在时间 t t 处评估的计划 ATF 是有限的（ A ​ [ p ] ​ ( t ) ∈ ℝ A[p](t)\in\mathbb{R} ）。 一个部分计划 p i , j := s i − 1 , e i , s i , … , e j , s j ∈ p p_{i,j}:=s_{i-1},e_{i},s_{i},...,e_{j},s_{j}\in p 是完整计划 p p 的一个子序列，其中 e i ∈ p e_{i}\in p 表示 p p 中的第 i i 条边（从 e 1 e_{1} 开始计数），而 s i ∈ p s_{i}\in p 表示第 i i 个状态（从 s 0 s_{0} 开始计数）。

paragraphs.en: A breakpoint of an ATF is a point where the slope of the ATF changes or the underlying plan changes.
paragraphs.zh: ATF 的断点是指 ATF 的斜率发生变化的点，或底层计划发生变化的点。

The breakpoints ζ 1 , α 1 , α 2 \zeta_{1},\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2} and, β 2 \beta_{2} are primitive images, as they are the time-shifted breakpoints of an edge ATF. paragraphs.en: Our proof of the linear complexity of the Any-start-time solution (see Section 6.1.2 ) will constrain the number of each type of breakpoint. In overview, each breakpoint of an edge ATF in the Augmented SIPP graph can result in only one primitive image in the solution and every pair of minimization breakpoints must have at least one primitive image between them. This means the solution has breakpoints linear in the number of edges in the graph.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对“任意开始时间解”的线性复杂性的证明（见第 6.1.2 节）将限制每种类型断点的数量。 总体而言，增强型 SIPP 图中一条边 ATF 的每个断点最多只能产生解中的一个原始图像，并且每对最小化断点之间必须至少有一个原始图像。 这意味着该解中的断点数量与图中的边数呈线性关系。

paragraphs.en: To make it easier to follow the complexity proof, we illustrate examples of each combination of plan ATFs that lead to each type of compound ATF breakpoint: ζ \zeta image (see Figure 13 ), β \beta image (see Figure 15 ), α \alpha image (see Figure 14 ), and minimization breakpoints (see Figure 16 ). The key aspect we are concerned with is: what is the slope immediately prior to the breakpoint and what is the slope immediately after. For each type of breakpoint, only certain combinations of these two slopes are possible. Individually, the slopes present in ATFs are: { − ∞ , 0 , 1 , ∞ } \{-\infty,0,1,\infty\} , where − ∞ -\infty corresponds to the discontinuous decrease prior to ζ \zeta (where the ATF is ∞ \infty because the source state is unsafe) and ∞ \infty is the discontinuous increase that can happen when a plan expires (at β \beta ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了更清晰地理解复杂性证明，我们将展示每种组合计划 ATF 导致每种复合 ATF 断点的示例：ζ \zeta 图像（见图 13）、β \beta 图像（见图 15）、α \alpha 图像（见图 14）以及最小化断点（见图 16）。 我们关注的关键问题是：断点前一刻的斜率是多少，断点后一刻的斜率又是多少。 对于每种类型的断点，只有特定的两种斜率组合是可能的。 单独来看，ATF 中出现的斜率有：{ − ∞ , 0 , 1 , ∞ } \{-\infty,0,1,\infty\}，其中 − ∞ -\infty 对应 ζ \zeta 之前的不连续下降（此时 ATF 为 ∞ \infty，因为源状态不安全），而 ∞ \infty 则是在计划到期时（在 β \beta 处）可能发生的不连续上升。

paragraphs.en: Figure 13 shows the two combinations of slopes that are possible for a ζ \zeta image. In both cases, the prior slope is − ∞ -\infty because there is no plan prior to ζ \zeta . Because the plan is valid, there can not be a slope of ∞ \infty immediately after (Equation 7 ). Figure 13 a shows the first possible case, where the prior slope is − ∞ -\infty and ζ < α \zeta<\alpha so the after slope is 0 0 . In this case the ζ \zeta image is distinct because it does not share the same time with other breakpoints. Figure 13 b shows the second possible case, where the prior slope is still − ∞ -\infty , but ζ = α \zeta=\alpha so the after slope is 1 1 . In this case the ζ \zeta image and the α \alpha image share the same time, so the ζ \zeta image is not distinct.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 展示了 ζ \zeta 图像可能存在的两种坡度组合。 在这两种情况下，ζ \zeta 之前的坡度均为 − ∞ -\infty，因为在 ζ \zeta 之前没有计划。 由于该计划是有效的，因此 ζ \zeta 之后不能立即出现 ∞ \infty 的坡度（方程 7）。 图 13 a 展示了第一种可能的情况：ζ \zeta 之前的坡度为 − ∞ -\infty，且 ζ < α \zeta<\alpha，因此之后的坡度为 0 0。 在这种情况下，ζ \zeta 图像是独特的，因为它与其他断点不共享相同的时间。 图 13 b 展示了第二种可能的情况：ζ \zeta 之前的坡度仍为 − ∞ -\infty，但 ζ = α \zeta=\alpha，因此之后的坡度为 1 1。 在这种情况下，ζ \zeta 图像和 α \alpha 图像共享相同的时间，因此 ζ \zeta 图像并不独特。

paragraphs.en: Figure 14 shows the four combinations of slopes that are possible for an α \alpha image. There are two possible prior slopes. First if α = ζ \alpha=\zeta , then we are in the same case as the example shown in Figure 13 b. Otherwise, α > ζ \alpha>\zeta and the second configuration that results in an α \alpha image is that α < β \alpha<\beta , an example of which is shown in Figure 14 b. Here the prior slope is 0 0 and the after slope is 1 1 and the α \alpha image is distinct. The third example is when α = β \alpha=\beta and is shown in Figure 14 c. In this example, the after slope is ∞ \infty because of the plan expiring at α \alpha . This α \alpha image is not distinct because there must also be a corresponding β \beta image. There is also a minimization breakpoint b ′ b^{\prime} , which (to torture our notation) is lim ϵ → 0 ϵ \lim_{\epsilon\to 0}\epsilon time units ‘after’ the α \alpha and β \beta images, which is to say though it has different slopes ( ∞ \infty prior and 0 0 after in this case) it is not distinct from the α \alpha image either. The fourth case is shown in Figure 14 d, where the prior slope is ∞ \infty , and the after slope is 1 1 , in this case the α \alpha image, α 2 \alpha_{2} is not distinct from the α 1 \alpha_{1} and β 1 \beta_{1} images for the same reason as the previous example. The remaining cases are: 5) when the after slope is − ∞ -\infty , which is not possible (see Equation 6 ); and 6) when the after slope is 0 0 , which is not possible, as either the prior slope is 0 0 and there is no breakpoint, or the prior slope is one of − ∞ -\infty and ∞ \infty and the breakpoint is the only time that the corresponding ATF is not dominated so that zero duration interval can be safely removed from the compound ATF (though it may still be optimal for a later time interval, for example consider if A ⁡ [ p 3 ] A[p_{3}] in Figure 11 were shifted later by one unit in arrival time).
paragraphs.zh: 图 14 展示了 α 图像可能出现的四种坡度组合。 存在两种可能的先验坡度。 首先，如果 α = ζ，那么我们就处于与图 13 b 所示示例相同的情况。 否则，α > ζ，而生成 α 图像的另一种配置是 α < β，其示例如图 14 b 所示。 在此情况下，先验坡度为 0，后验坡度为 1，且 α 图像是独特的。 第三个示例是当 α = β 时，如图 14 c 所示。 在此示例中，由于计划在 α 时刻到期，后验坡度为 ∞。 这个 α 图像并非独特，因为必然也存在一个对应的 β 图像。 此外还存在一个最小化断点 b′（为了折磨我们的记法，可以表示为 lim_{ε→0} ε 时间单位），它位于 α 和 β 图像的“之后”；也就是说，尽管它的坡度不同（在此情况下是先验坡度为 ∞，后验坡度为 0），但它与 α 图像也并非独特。 第四种情况如图 14 d 所示，其中先验坡度为 ∞，后验坡度为 1；在这种情况下，α 图像 α₂ 与 α₁ 和 β₁ 图像并非独特，原因与上一个示例相同。 剩下的情况是：5）当后验坡度为 −∞ 时，这是不可能的（参见方程 6）；以及 6）当后验坡度为 0 时，这也是不可能的，因为此时要么先验坡度为 0 且不存在断点，要么先验坡度为 −∞ 或 ∞，而断点是唯一使得对应的 ATF 不被支配的时刻，因此可以从复合 ATF 中安全地移除零持续时间的区间（尽管对于后续的时间区间来说，它可能仍然是最优的，例如考虑图 11 中的 A[p₃] 如果其到达时间向后移动一个单位）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 15 shows the four possible configurations for a β \beta image. It is impossible for the prior or after slope of a β \beta image to be − ∞ -\infty (Equation 7 ). paragraphs.en: Figure 16 shows the two possible configurations for minimization breakpoints. By definition, the ATF around a minimization breakpoint must be continuous (however, not the same slope) so the prior and after slope must be finite. Also, by definition, there must be a different ATF optimal prior to the minimization breakpoint (henceforth the prior ATF) and after (the after ATF). If the prior slope was 0 0 , then the after ATF would dominate the prior ATF, so the prior slope must be 1 1 . Figure 16 a shows the example where the after slope is 0 0 0 and Figure 16 b shows the example where the after slope is 1 1 . When the after slope is 1 1 , as in this example, there might be many possible times to assign as the minimization breakpoint, depending on when the algorithm decides to switch from the prior ATF to the after ATF in the interval [ b , b ′ ] [b,b^{\prime}] where they are both optimal. What is important is that there should only be one such breakpoint, there is no reason for the compound AFT to switch back and forth between the prior and after ATF. Given that, notice that because the prior slope for a minimization breakpoint must be 1 1 , any (non redundant) pair of minimization breakpoints must have an α \alpha breakpoint between them.

paragraphs.en: The time complexity of RePEAT is determined by how many times the inner Augmented SIPP routine is called. We will show that RePEAT runs only a linear number of calls to Augmented SIPP. In our setting, as a best-first search like Dijkstra’s algorithm, the runtime of aSIPP αβ is O ⁡ ( | E | ​ l ​ o ​ g ​ ( | V | ) ) O(|E|log(|V|)) where | E | |E| is the number of edge ATFs in our problem, and | V | |V| is the number of SIPP states.
paragraphs.zh: RePEAT 的时间复杂度取决于内部增广 SIPP 程序被调用的次数。 我们将证明，RePEAT 对增广 SIPP 的调用次数仅为线性级别。 在我们的设定中，由于 aSIPP αβ 类似于迪杰斯特拉算法的最佳优先搜索，其运行时间为 O⁡(|E|log(|V|))，其中 |E| 是我们问题中边的 ATF 数量，而 |V| 是 SIPP 状态的数量。

sents.zh: RePEAT 的时间复杂度取决于内部增广 SIPP 程序被调用的次数。

paragraphs.en: The runtime of RePEAT is O ⁡ ( ( | E | + | V | ) ​ | E | ​ l ​ o ​ g ​ ( | V | ) ) O((|E|+|V|)|E|log(|V|)) .
paragraphs.zh: RePEAT 的运行时间为 O ⁡ ( ( | E | + | V | ) ​ | E | ​ l ​ o ​ g ​ ( | V | ) ) O((|E|+|V|)|E|log(|V|))。

paragraphs.en: Each time the reference time is updated, we are either including a plan ATF (with at least one associated primitive image) in the compound ATF or eliminating a primitive image from being in the compound ATF. In the case where Augmented SIPP returns a plan that is not dominated by the existing compound ATF, then after the reference time update, that same plan will not be returned again, unless that round of search also expanded a node corresponding to the plan ATF that set the reference time, which eliminates the associated α \alpha image from future searches. The number of such breakpoints is | E | + | V | |E|+|V| , so at most that many rounds of Augmented SIPP will be required, leading to an overall worst-case runtime of O ⁡ ( ( | E | + | V | ) ​ | E | ​ l ​ o ​ g ​ ( | V | ) ) O((|E|+|V|)|E|log(|V|)) which is quasi-quadratic in the number of safe intervals in G G ( | E | + | V | |E|+|V| ). ∎
paragraphs.zh: 每次更新参考时间时，我们要么将某个计划 ATF（至少包含一个相关的原始图像）纳入复合 ATF，要么从复合 ATF 中移除一个原始图像。 如果增强型 SIPP 返回的计划不被现有的复合 ATF 所支配，那么在参考时间更新后，该计划将不再被返回，除非该轮搜索还扩展了与设定参考时间的计划 ATF 相对应的节点，从而将相关的 α \alpha 图像排除在未来的搜索之外。 此类断点的数量为 | E | + | V | |E|+|V|，因此最多需要相同数量的增强型 SIPP 轮次，导致整体最坏情况运行时间为 O ⁡ ( ( | E | + | V | ) ​ | E | ​ l ​ o ​ g ​ ( | V | ) ) O((|E|+|V|)|E|log(|V|))，这在 G G ( | E | + | V | |E|+|V|) 中的安全区间数量上是准二次的。 ∎
