paragraphs.en: It is natural to wonder how useful any of these techniques are in practice. To evaluate their behavior concretely in a popular dynamic planning problem, we ran a series of experiments on path planning in 2D grids among time-dependent obstacles (the domain in which SIPP was originally demonstrated). We address questions in three different categories: 1) The practicality of Augmented SIPP on its own: What is the overhead of Augmented SIPP compared to original SIPP? 2) The adequacy of replanning: How extreme must problems get before Replanning SIPP becomes an inadequate solution? 3) The practicality of RePEAT: How complex are any-start-time plans in practice? How long do they take to compute? Can they be queried quickly?
paragraphs.zh: 人们很自然地会想知道，这些技术在实际应用中究竟有多大用处。 为了在一个流行的动态规划问题中具体评估它们的表现，我们在一个包含时间相关障碍物的二维网格路径规划问题上进行了一系列实验（这也是 SIPP 最初被验证的领域）。 我们从三个不同类别的问题入手：1) 增强型 SIPP 本身的实用性：与原始 SIPP 相比，增强型 SIPP 会带来多少额外开销？2) 重新规划的有效性：问题必须达到多么严重的程度，Replanning SIPP 才会成为一个不充分的解决方案？3) RePEAT 的实用性：在实际应用中，“任意起始时间”的规划有多复杂？ 它们的计算需要多长时间？ 它们能否被快速查询？

paragraphs.en: We begin by describing our experimental set-up, our C++ implementation of RePEAT and the other algorithms, the hardware used to evaluate the performance, and how we generated the problem instances used in this evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先介绍我们的实验设置、RePEAT 及其其他算法的 C++ 实现、用于评估性能的硬件，以及我们如何生成本次评估中使用的问题实例。

paragraphs.en: We implemented the algorithms used in our experiments in a modern C++ code base. For these experiments, we used GCC 15.2.1 and Boost 1.88.0 with -O3 optimization. We use the Boost n_ary_heap data structure with an arity of 4 4 to implement our open lists (we found this to outperform std::priority_queue and a n_ary_heap with arity 2). Where possible, the implementations of our algorithms share data structures and code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将实验中使用的算法实现于一个现代化的 C++ 代码库中。 在这些实验中，我们使用了 GCC 15.2.1 和 Boost 1.88.0，并启用了 -O3 优化。 我们使用 Boost 的 n_ary_heap 数据结构（其分支度为 4）来实现开放列表（我们发现这种结构的表现优于 std::priority_queue 以及分支度为 2 的 n_ary_heap）。 在可能的情况下，我们算法的实现共享了数据结构和代码。

paragraphs.en: Our test problems are adapted from maps and scenarios from the Moving AI Lab 2D Pathfinding Benchmarks [ 38 ] . We selected three maps — den520d (Figure 17(a) , trees are shown as green and considered impassible), random (Figure 17(c) ), and rooms (Figure 17(e) ) — to provide three contrasting static environments. Rooms and den520d were selected, in part, to correspond with prior SIPP papers, which have used these or similar maps for their experiments. Rooms provides a static environment with regularly shaped and spaced local minima to increase the challenge of the search, while den520d consists of larger irregular rooms connected by long hallways. The random map contrasts with the other two, with small local minima but many near-optimal plans, providing an intermediate difficulty between the easier den520d and the more challenging rooms. The den520d map is 256x257, while the other two maps are 512x512.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的测试问题改编自 Moving AI Lab 2D 路径规划基准 [38] 中的地图和场景。 我们选择了三张地图——den520d（图 17(a)，其中树木显示为绿色且被视为不可通行）、random（图 17(c)）和 rooms（图 17(e)）——以提供三种截然不同的静态环境。 选择 rooms 和 den520d 部分是为了与早期的 SIPP 论文相对应，这些论文在实验中使用了这些或类似的地图。 rooms 提供了一个静态环境，其中具有形状和间距规则的局部最小值，从而增加了搜索的难度；而 den520d 则由通过长走廊连接的大型不规则房间组成。 random 地图与其他两张形成对比：它包含较小的局部最小值，但有许多接近最优的规划方案，因此在难度上介于较简单的 den520d 和更具挑战性的 rooms 之间。 den520d 地图的尺寸为 256x257，而另外两张地图的尺寸均为 512x512。

paragraphs.en: For each problem instance, we populated the static map with random obstacles that make their locations unsafe for a random duration. The instance generation is controlled by three parameters: minDuration, maxDuration, and occupancy. Occupancy is the odds that a location will be unsafe at a particular time. The sequence of states for each location are generated by appending a safe interval with duration drawn from the continuous uniform distribution from minDuration to maxDuration, then an unsafe interval with duration drawn from the continuous uniform distribution between 0 and occupancy times the average safe duration ( 𝑜𝑐𝑐𝑢𝑝𝑎𝑛𝑐𝑦 ∗ 𝑚𝑎𝑥𝐷𝑢𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 − 𝑚𝑖𝑛𝐷𝑢𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 2 \mathit{occupancy}*\frac{\mathit{maxDuration}-\mathit{minDuration}}{2} ). So an occupancy of 0 yields an instance with no time-dependent obstacles, 1 yields an instance where every location is unsafe half of the time on average.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个问题实例，我们在静态地图中填充了随机障碍物，这些障碍物的位置在随机时长内处于不安全状态。 实例生成由三个参数控制：minDuration、maxDuration 和 occupancy。 Occupancy 表示某个位置在特定时间处于不安全状态的概率。 每个位置的序列状态通过以下方式生成：先附加一个安全时段，其持续时间从 minDuration 到 maxDuration 的连续均匀分布中抽取；然后附加一个不安全时段，其持续时间从 0 到 occupancy 乘以平均安全时长（𝑜𝑐𝑐𝑢𝑝𝑎𝑛𝑐𝑦 ∗ 𝑚𝑎𝑥𝐷𝑢𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 − 𝑚𝑖𝑛𝐷𝑢𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 2 \mathit{occupancy}*\frac{\mathit{maxDuration}-\mathit{minDuration}}{2}）的连续均匀分布中抽取。 因此，occupancy 为 0 时生成的实例不含任何与时间相关的障碍物；而 occupancy 为 1 时，平均而言每个位置有一半的时间处于不安全状态。

paragraphs.en: To simplify the generation of viable random instances, we set the start and goal to be always safe. After 2000 time units, all states become unsafe to provide a finite horizon for the random safe interval generation. We have taken care to use a pseudo-random number generator that, for the same random seed, generates the same sequence of random instances even when run on different machines or compiled with different compilers or Boost library versions, so the same start and goal location on the same static map with the same generation parameters should produce the same SIPP problem instance no matter what computer it is run on. For our experiments, we generate one instance for each scenario provided along with the static problem instances. For den520d, there are 870 scenarios, for random512, there are 1780, and for 64room, there are 2300.
paragraphs.zh: 为简化可行随机实例的生成，我们将起点和终点始终设为安全状态。 经过 2000 个时间单位后，所有状态均变为不安全状态，从而为随机安全区间的生成提供有限时域。 我们特意使用了一个伪随机数生成器：对于相同的随机种子，即使在不同机器上运行或使用不同的编译器或 Boost 库版本进行编译，它也会生成相同的随机实例序列。因此，在相同的静态地图上，使用相同的起点和终点位置以及相同的生成参数，无论在哪台计算机上运行，都应该产生相同的 SIPP 问题实例。 在我们的实验中，我们为每个随附的静态问题实例所对应的场景生成一个实例。 den520d 有 870 个场景，random512 有 1780 个，而 64room 则有 2300 个。

paragraphs.en: In general, the goal of our empirical tests is to characterize the performance of our algorithms on non-trivial problems. Towards this, the objective of our first experiment is to determine what settings for the three parameters (minDuration, maxDuration, and occupancy) produce computationally challenging instances that still mostly have solutions (as any-start-time planning on an unsolvable instance finds the same ‘no solution’ result as SIPP). Towards this, we run SIPP on sets of instances generated with (minDuration, maxDuration) ∈ { ( 5 , 50 ) , ( 10,100 ) , ( 50,500 ) } \in\{(5,50),(10,100),(50,500)\} and occupancy varying uniformly with 9 9 values from 0.05 0.05 to 0.93 0.93 .
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们实证测试的目标是描述我们的算法在非平凡问题上的性能表现。 为此，我们第一个实验的目标是确定三个参数（minDuration、maxDuration 和 occupancy）的哪些设置能够生成计算上具有挑战性的实例，同时这些实例大多仍然存在解（因为对于不可解的实例，任何起始时间的规划都会得到与 SIPP 相同的“无解”结果）。 为此，我们在通过 (minDuration, maxDuration) ∈ { (5, 50), (10, 100), (50, 500) } 和 occupancy 在 0.05 到 0.93 之间以 9 个均匀值变化而生成的一组实例上运行 SIPP。

sents.zh: 总体而言，我们实证测试的目标是描述我们的算法在非平凡问题上的性能表现。

paragraphs.en: Figure 18 shows the geometric mean runtime and the percentage of instances where Augmented SIPP proved that no feasible solution exists for the three maps and three sets of random interval durations. In several (especially Figure 18(f) ), we see a similar ‘phase transition’ that has been observed in related problems, such as the TSP with time windows [ 34 ] . The transition is from low occupancy, where there are few obstacles and many feasible solutions, to high occupancy, where there are few, if any, feasible solutions. In both extremes, the search is relatively easy, with few obstacles it amounts to static grid pathplanning, and with many, there are so few viable successors that the search can quickly find the only solution if it exists, or eliminate all possible plans if it does not. It is in the intermediate area where the search is the most challenging, which results in the peaks in the runtimes shown in Figure 18 .
paragraphs.zh: 图 18 展示了三种地图和三种随机区间持续时间集合下，Augmented SIPP 证明不存在可行解的实例的几何平均运行时间和百分比。 在多个案例中（尤其是图 18(f)），我们观察到一种与 TSP 时间窗口问题 [34] 等相关问题中已发现的类似“相变”现象。 这种转变是从低占用状态（障碍物少、可行解多）到高占用状态（可行解极少甚至不存在）的过渡。 在这两种极端情况下，搜索都相对容易：在障碍物较少的情况下，这相当于静态网格路径规划；而在障碍物众多的情况下，可行的后续状态极少，因此如果存在唯一解，搜索能迅速找到它；如果不存在，则能排除所有可能的计划。 正是在中间区域，搜索最具挑战性，这也导致了图 18 中运行时间曲线出现峰值。

paragraphs.en: The den520d instances are roughly an order of magnitude easier than the random512 and 64room instances. Examining what proportion of the instances are solvable, we find that the long random intervals result in many unsolvable instances with larger occupancies ( [ 50,500 ] [50,500] ), while [ 5 , 50 ] [5,50] and [ 10,100 ] [10,100] are more similar to each other. Overall, den520d results in fewer unsolvable instances, with more for random512, and even more for 64room. With this in mind, we select the settings: minDuration = 10 =10 , maxDuration = 100 =100 , and occupancy = 0.35 =0.35 because these settings avoid all of the unsolvable instances for den520d and random512, along with most of the unsolvable instances for 64room. The average runtimes are sufficiently long to accurately measure, and the occupancy is high enough that we expect the agent to encounter temporal obstacles, leading different plans to be optimal for different start times, and any-start-time planning to be of use.
paragraphs.zh: den520d 实例的难度大致比 random512 和 64room 实例低一个数量级。 考察可解实例的比例，我们发现较长的随机间隔会导致更多在较高占用率下无法解决的实例（[50,500]），而 [5,50] 和 [10,100] 之间的差异则相对较小。 总体而言，den520d 产生的不可解实例较少，random512 的不可解实例更多，64room 的情况则更为严重。 基于此，我们选择以下设置：minDuration = 10，maxDuration = 100，以及 occupancy = 0.35，因为这些设置能够避免 den520d 和 random512 的所有不可解实例，同时也能规避 64room 的大部分不可解实例。 平均运行时间足够长以确保测量的准确性，而占用率也足够高，使得智能体预计会遇到时间相关的障碍，从而导致不同起始时间下最优计划的不同，以及任何起始时间规划方法都具有实际价值。

paragraphs.en: The experiments were performed on a cluster of 15 identical desktop machines with Intel 4.3GHz i3-12100 quad-core CPUs and 64 GB RAM, with one experiment at a time run on each machine (and no other programs running on the same machine). All timings measure only the search itself, excluding generation of safe intervals from random obstacles and I/O, which are shared by all the tested algorithms. We measured the expansion rate of our SIPP and Augmented SIPP implementations at about 1 MHz on non-trivial problem instances. Specifically, Figure 19 shows the expansion rate and generation rate of SIPP on each instance tested to set the parameters for the random instance generation (the same set of instances as in Figure 18 ). Over all instances requiring more than 10,000 10,000 expansions, we measure the geometric mean expansion rate at 970,000 970,000 Hz with a 95 % 95\% confidence interval of 968,400 − 971,800 968,400-971,800 Hz. Especially on smaller problems, larger random intervals can lead to a lower branching factor and a faster expansion rate.
paragraphs.zh: 实验在一组由 15 台相同的台式机组成的集群上执行，这些计算机配备英特尔 4.3GHz i3-12100 四核 CPU 和 64 GB RAM，每次仅在一台机器上运行一个实验（且同一台机器上不运行任何其他程序）。 所有计时仅测量搜索过程本身，不包括从随机障碍物生成安全区间以及输入/输出操作的时间，因为这些时间是所有测试算法共用的。 我们在非平凡问题实例上测得 SIPP 和增强型 SIPP 实现的扩展速率约为 1 MHz。 具体而言，图 19 展示了 SIPP 在每个测试实例上的扩展速率和生成速率，用于设置随机实例生成的参数（使用的实例集与图 18 中的相同）。 在所有需要超过 10,000 次扩展的实例中，我们测得几何平均扩展速率为 970,000 Hz，95% 置信区间为 968,400-971,800 Hz。 尤其是在较小的问题上，较大的随机区间可能导致较低的分支因子和更快的扩展速率。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we address our first research question: how practical is Augmented SIPP? We answer this question by comparing the runtime of SIPP and Augmented SIPP on identical problem instances. If there is little to no overhead, then Augmented SIPP is at least as practical as SIPP. We calculate the overhead of Augmented SIPP on a problem instance as the percent difference of the runtime of Augmented SIPP ( r A ​ S ​ I ​ P ​ P r_{ASIPP} ) and SIPP ( r S ​ I ​ P ​ P r_{SIPP} ) divided by their average runtime:

sents.en: If there is little to no overhead, then Augmented SIPP is at least as practical as SIPP.

sents.en: We calculate the overhead of Augmented SIPP on a problem instance as the percent difference of the runtime of Augmented SIPP ( r A ​ S ​ I ​ P ​ P r_{ASIPP} ) and SIPP ( r S ​ I ​ P ​ P r_{SIPP} ) divided by their average runtime:
sents.zh: 我们在某个问题实例上计算增强型 SIPP 的额外开销，即增强型 SIPP 的运行时间（ r A ​ S ​ I ​ P ​ P r_{ASIPP} ）与 SIPP 的运行时间（ r S ​ I ​ P ​ P r_{SIPP} ）之间的百分比差异，再除以它们的平均运行时间：

paragraphs.en: Figure 20 shows the distributions of overhead for Augmented SIPP on our random instances. We observe a median overhead of − 2 % , − 8 % , -2\%,-8\%, and − 11 % -11\% respectively for den520d, random512, and 64room. paragraphs.en: Our implementations of SIPP and Augmented SIPP use the same basic data structures for open and closed, and differ only as it relates to the calculation and representation of g g during successor generation. They are both run on identical instances, and we have confirmed that both expand and generate the same number of nodes, confirming that our implementations are performing the same search (see Observation 2 ). One difference that could be a possible source of this speedup is that Augmented SIPP only fetches a single object from memory to generate a successor, the edge ATF. In contrast, SIPP may need to fetch the safe intervals for the source state of the edge, the destination state of the edge, and the edge itself.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 SIPP 和增强型 SIPP 的实现使用了相同的开放和封闭基本数据结构，仅在生成后继状态时计算和表示 g g 的方式上有所不同。 两者均在相同的实例上运行，并且我们已经确认两者展开和生成的节点数量相同，这表明我们的实现执行了相同的搜索（参见观察 2）。 一个可能成为这种加速来源的差异是，增强型 SIPP 在生成后继状态时仅从内存中获取单个对象，即边 ATF。 相比之下，SIPP 可能需要获取边的源状态的 안전 구간、边的目标状态的 안전 구간以及边本身。

paragraphs.en: Given these results, in situations where the path ATF can be useful, such as knowing for how long the SIPP plan is optimal or valid, Augmented SIPP appears to be a very practical algorithm in its own right.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于这些结果，在 ATF 路径能够发挥作用的情况下（例如，了解 SIPP 计划在多长时间范围内是最优或有效的），增强型 SIPP 本身似乎是一种非常实用的算法。

paragraphs.en: We also measure the overhead of aSIPP αβ in the same manner as Augmented SIPP. Compared to SIPP, aSIPP αβ should be expected to need to expand more nodes, because it is able to do less pruning (dominance only vs SIPP pruning on ≤ ↓ f ↑ g \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow g} ), this may be especially detrimental in a 2D grid setting where ties are common. The runtime overhead of aSIPP αβ over Augmented SIPP is shown in Figure 21 a-c. The runtime can be over 100x that of Augmented SIPP with the usual node ordering and pruning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们也以与增强型 SIPP 相同的方式测量 aSIPP αβ 的额外开销。 与 SIPP 相比，aSIPP αβ 预计需要扩展更多节点，因为它能够进行的剪枝较少（仅支配性剪枝 vs SIPP 在 ≤ ↓ f ↑ g \leq_{\downarrow f\uparrow g} 上的剪枝），这在打平情况常见的二维网格设置中可能尤其不利。 aSIPP αβ 相对于增强型 SIPP 的运行时间开销如图 21a-c 所示。 在采用常规节点排序和剪枝的情况下，其运行时间可能超过增强型 SIPP 的 100 倍。

paragraphs.en: To examine the cause of this, Figure 21 d-f shows the number of expansions done by aSIPP αβ as a function of the number of expansions done by SIPP. For each map, we perform a log-linear least squares to fit a power function of the form y = a ​ x b y=ax^{b} to the problem instances with more than 10 4 10^{4} SIPP expansions. Qualitatively, all three maps appear to be well fit by power functions of a relatively low power. This indicates that our aSIPP αβ searches are generally doing more expansions, but not exponentially more expansions than the corresponding SIPP search.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究这一现象的原因，图21 d-f展示了aSIPP αβ所执行扩展次数与SIPP所执行扩展次数之间的关系。 对于每张地图，我们对包含超过10⁴次SIPP扩展的问题实例进行对数线性最小二乘拟合，以匹配形如 y = a x^b 的幂函数。 从定性角度来看，这三张地图似乎都能被幂指数相对较低的幂函数很好地拟合。 这表明我们的aSIPP αβ搜索通常执行更多次扩展，但并非比相应的SIPP搜索呈指数级增长。

paragraphs.en: We measured the duration for which the SIPP plans remain valid (not necessarily optimal) and compared that to the runtime of the search used to find those plans. If the runtime of the search is longer than the duration that the plan remains valid, then the agent will not be able to initiate execution when planning completes and instead will need to immediately replan again. In fact, replanning may fail indefinitely, causing the agent to be stuck forever at the start state. Our objective is to see if any of our problem instances approach this region, where replanning is not as viable because of the cadence of the problem.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测量了 SIPP 计划保持有效（不一定是最优）的持续时间，并将其与用于寻找这些计划的搜索运行时间进行了比较。 如果搜索的运行时间超过了计划保持有效的持续时间，那么智能体在规划完成时将无法启动执行，而必须立即重新规划。 事实上，重新规划可能会无限期失败，导致智能体永远困在初始状态。 我们的目标是观察我们任何问题实例是否接近这一区域——在该区域中，由于问题的节奏，重新规划不再那么可行。

sents.zh: 我们测量了 SIPP 计划保持有效（不一定是最优）的持续时间，并将其与用于寻找这些计划的搜索运行时间进行了比较。

sents.zh: 事实上，重新规划可能会无限期失败，导致智能体永远困在初始状态。

sents.en: Our objective is to see if any of our problem instances approach this region, where replanning is not as viable because of the cadence of the problem.
sents.zh: 我们的目标是观察我们任何问题实例是否接近这一区域——在该区域中，由于问题的节奏，重新规划不再那么可行。

paragraphs.en: Figure 22 shows the results. In red is the region where the plan is valid for less time than it takes to compute. In most of the tested instances, planning is faster than the plans become invalid. However, for each map, there were some instances ( 0.6 % , 10.8 % 0.6\%,10.8\% , and 11.1 % 11.1\% for den520d, random512, and 64room respectively) where planning took longer than the resulting plan was valid for. Therefore, especially in the two more challenging maps there are already many instances where replanning would be an inadequate substitute for any-start-time planning, even though we are in a setting where planning takes milliseconds. If, we have the plan ATF produced by Augmented SIPP, we will know immediately that the execution will fail. Or, had we had planned an any-start-time plan offline, execution would have succeeded because the on-line planning time would have been negligible. In these problems, an agent that relied on simple replanning SIPP could become paralyzed, repeatedly being unable to plan fast enough to enact the resulting plan. Worse, a SIPP agent may not realize that the plan is invalid until it has executed most of the plan, potentially leaving it in an unsafe situation.
paragraphs.zh: 图22展示了结果。 红色区域表示计划的有效时间短于计算所需的时间。 在大多数测试实例中，规划的速度快于计划失效的时间。 然而，对于每张地图，都存在一些实例（den520d、random512和64room分别占0.6%、10.8%和11.1%），其中规划所需时间超过了最终计划的有效时间。 因此，尤其是在两张更具挑战性的地图中，已经存在许多实例，在这些实例中重新规划无法替代任何起始时间的规划，尽管我们的规划过程仅需数毫秒。 如果我们拥有增强型SIPP生成的ATF计划，就能立即知道执行将会失败。 或者，如果我们在离线阶段规划了一个任何起始时间的计划，执行就会成功，因为在线规划的时间可以忽略不计。 在这些问题中，依赖简单重新规划SIPP的智能体可能会陷入瘫痪，因为它反复无法足够快地规划以执行生成的计划。 更糟糕的是，SIPP智能体可能直到执行了大部分计划才发现该计划无效，这可能会使其陷入不安全的情况。

paragraphs.en: The runtime performance of RePEAT depends on the speed of the aSIPP αβ searches and how many searches were run. Figure 23 shows the number of reference time updates (searches run) for RePEAT to generate any-start-time plans for the first 100 seconds on our benchmark instances. In all three, we see two sorts of instances: one cluster of instances with high runtime but few reference time updates, which we will call the ‘low-level’ hard instances because their time is spent on a few hard Augmented SIPP searches, and a distribution of instances with a number of reference time updates that scales proportionally to the runtime, which we will call the ‘high-level’ hard instances because their difficulty comes from having a more complicated any-start-time plan, that requires many more (but less challenging) Augmented SIPP searches. Note that the color scale of Figure 23 is logarithmic, as otherwise only the low-level hard instances are visible for random512 and 64room.
paragraphs.zh: RePEAT 的运行时间性能取决于 aSIPP αβ 搜索的速度以及执行了多少次搜索。 图 23 展示了 RePEAT 在我们的基准实例上，于最初 100 秒内生成任意开始时间计划时所需的参考时间更新次数（即执行的搜索次数）。 在这三种情况下，我们都观察到两类实例：一类是运行时间较长但参考时间更新较少的实例群，我们将其称为“低层级”难题实例，因为它们的运行时间主要用于少数复杂的增强 SIPP 搜索；另一类则是参考时间更新次数与运行时间呈比例关系的实例分布，我们将其称为“高层级”难题实例，因为其难度源于更复杂的任意开始时间计划，需要执行更多（但挑战性较低的）增强 SIPP 搜索。 请注意，图 23 的颜色标度是对数形式的，否则在 random512 和 64room 实例中，只有“低层级”难题实例会显示出来。

paragraphs.en: This difference in the frequency of low-level hard instances may be because random512 and 64room have many tight bottlenecks, which might result in simpler ATFs, with plans that change due mostly to the deadlines at those bottlenecks. In contrast, in den520d where there are not particularly tight bottlenecks in the static graph, the optimal plan may change very frequently, resulting in performance that is closer to our theoretical bounds on the worst case performance of RePEAT.
paragraphs.zh: 低难度实例出现频率的这种差异，可能是因为 random512 和 64room 存在许多非常紧张的瓶颈，这可能导致其 ATF 更简单，而计划的变化主要源于这些瓶颈处的截止日期。 相比之下，在 den520d 中，静态图并没有特别紧张的瓶颈，因此最优计划可能会频繁变化，导致其性能更接近我们关于 RePEAT 最坏情况性能的理论界限。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows the percentage of instances for which RePEAT found a 100s any-start-time plan within the 30 min time limit and within 100s. We seem to have designed the instances to be sufficiently challenging to accurately measure RePEAT’s performance. Even though the test instances are quite congested with changing obstacles, many instances still plan fast enough that RePEAT would be able to be used on-line in an anytime manner (because it takes less than 100 seconds to plan for the next 100 seconds). Interestingly, though den520d was the easiest map for SIPP, it is the most challenging for RePEAT.

paragraphs.en: We discuss applications of any-start-time planning as well as its relationship with related topics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们讨论了任意开始时间规划的应用及其与相关主题的关系。

paragraphs.en: We motivated any-start-time planning using scenarios where an agent did not know the plan execution start time in advance, but that is only the most obvious application. For example, any-start-time plans contain information that agents can use to assess trade-offs. To continue our delivery robot example, suppose the robot, while it is waiting for the original meal to be ready, is offered the opportunity to deliver a second meal. If the robot has an any-start-time plan for the original delivery, it can use that to evaluate the potential tradeoff in arrival time for the first meal if it were to depart and deliver the second meal first instead of continuing to wait.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一些场景来论证任何开始时间规划的价值：在这些场景中，智能体事先并不知道计划执行的确切开始时间，但这只是最明显的应用场景。 例如，任何开始时间的计划都包含信息，智能体可以利用这些信息来评估不同选择之间的权衡。 继续以我们的配送机器人为例，假设机器人在等待第一份餐食准备就绪的同时，获得了配送第二份餐食的机会。 如果机器人已经为最初的配送任务制定了任何开始时间的计划，它就可以利用该计划来评估：如果先出发配送第二份餐食，而不是继续等待，那么第一份餐食的送达时间可能会产生怎样的权衡变化。

sents.en: We motivated any-start-time planning using scenarios where an agent did not know the plan execution start time in advance, but that is only the most obvious application.
sents.zh: 我们通过一些场景来论证任何开始时间规划的价值：在这些场景中，智能体事先并不知道计划执行的确切开始时间，但这只是最明显的应用场景。

sents.en: For example, any-start-time plans contain information that agents can use to assess trade-offs.
sents.zh: 例如，任何开始时间的计划都包含信息，智能体可以利用这些信息来评估不同选择之间的权衡。

sents.en: To continue our delivery robot example, suppose the robot, while it is waiting for the original meal to be ready, is offered the opportunity to deliver a second meal.
sents.zh: 继续以我们的配送机器人为例，假设机器人在等待第一份餐食准备就绪的同时，获得了配送第二份餐食的机会。

sents.en: If the robot has an any-start-time plan for the original delivery, it can use that to evaluate the potential tradeoff in arrival time for the first meal if it were to depart and deliver the second meal first instead of continuing to wait.
sents.zh: 如果机器人已经为最初的配送任务制定了任何开始时间的计划，它就可以利用该计划来评估：如果先出发配送第二份餐食，而不是继续等待，那么第一份餐食的送达时间可能会产生怎样的权衡变化。

paragraphs.en: The trade-offs that an agent makes can occur inside the planner itself. For example, a situated agent, one that seeks to minimize time-to-goal while planning online ‘as the clock ticks’ [ 5 , 6 ] , needs to decide whether additional search will result in a plan whose superiority justifies delaying execution. By having an any-start-time plan to metareason over, it can quickly evaluate the opportunity cost of delaying execution.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体所做的权衡可能发生在规划器内部。 例如，一个情境化智能体——即试图在在线规划时“随着时间推移”最小化到达目标所需时间的智能体 [5, 6]——需要决定：额外的搜索是否会产生一个其优越性足以证明延迟执行是合理的计划。 通过拥有一个可在任何起始时间进行元推理的计划，它可以快速评估延迟执行的机会成本。

sents.en: The trade-offs that an agent makes can occur inside the planner itself.
sents.zh: 智能体所做的权衡可能发生在规划器内部。

sents.en: For example, a situated agent, one that seeks to minimize time-to-goal while planning online ‘as the clock ticks’ [ 5 , 6 ] , needs to decide whether additional search will result in a plan whose superiority justifies delaying execution.
sents.zh: 例如，一个情境化智能体——即试图在在线规划时“随着时间推移”最小化到达目标所需时间的智能体 [5, 6]——需要决定：额外的搜索是否会产生一个其优越性足以证明延迟执行是合理的计划。

sents.en: By having an any-start-time plan to metareason over, it can quickly evaluate the opportunity cost of delaying execution.
sents.zh: 通过拥有一个可在任何起始时间进行元推理的计划，它可以快速评估延迟执行的机会成本。

paragraphs.en: An any-start-time plan does not need to refer to the agent’s primary activity — it can be useful as an emergency back-up. For example, consider a self-driving vehicle that maintains an any-start-time plan of avoidance maneuvers in case the car in front slams on the brakes.
paragraphs.zh: 任何开始时间的计划都不必涉及智能体的主要活动——它可作为应急备用方案发挥作用。 例如，设想一辆自动驾驶汽车，它会保持一份任何开始时间的避让操作计划，以防前车突然急刹车。

sents.en: An any-start-time plan does not need to refer to the agent’s primary activity — it can be useful as an emergency back-up.
sents.zh: 任何开始时间的计划都不必涉及智能体的主要活动——它可作为应急备用方案发挥作用。

sents.en: For example, consider a self-driving vehicle that maintains an any-start-time plan of avoidance maneuvers in case the car in front slams on the brakes.
sents.zh: 例如，设想一辆自动驾驶汽车，它会保持一份任何开始时间的避让操作计划，以防前车突然急刹车。

paragraphs.en: Any-start-time plans can also be useful in a multi-agent setting. If each agent has an any-start-time plan, a higher-level planner tasked with resolving conflicts can quickly query these plans to determine what the cost of delaying each agent would be. A decentralized multi-agent application was explored by [ 21 ] , who showed how any-start-time planning can be used to keep a railway network safe when a train is delayed. Each train views the others’ nominal plans as dynamic obstacles and maintains an any-start-time plan for how to reach its destination if it itself were to begin the next segment of its journey at a delayed time. When a delay happens, the affected train queries its any-start-time plan and instantly has its new safe route. It then informs the other trains of its new nominal plan, allowing them to adjust their any-start-time contingency plans in turn.
paragraphs.zh: 在任何时间开始的规划方案在多智能体环境中也可能很有用。 如果每个智能体都有一个任何时间开始的规划方案，那么负责解决冲突的更高级规划器就可以快速查询这些方案，以确定延迟每个智能体所带来的成本。 [ 21 ] 探索了一种去中心化的多智能体应用，并展示了如何利用任何时间开始的规划来确保铁路网络在列车延误时保持安全。 每列火车都将其他列车的正常规划视为动态障碍物，并维持一个任何时间开始的规划方案，用于说明如果自身因延迟而开始下一段行程时如何到达目的地。 当发生延误时，受影响的列车会查询其任何时间开始的规划方案，并立即获得新的安全路线。 随后，它会通知其他列车自己的新正常规划，从而让它们能够依次调整各自的任何时间开始的应急规划方案。

sents.en: Any-start-time plans can also be useful in a multi-agent setting.
sents.zh: 在任何时间开始的规划方案在多智能体环境中也可能很有用。

paragraphs.en: While our experimental evaluation focused on grid pathfinding, we emphasize that the methods we have discussed in this paper can apply to any planning problem in which the applicability or feasibility of states or actions varies over time and the objective is to achieve the goal as early as possible. If a problem can be represented in these terms, then it is possible to efficiently calculate any-start-time plans.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们的实验评估主要集中在网格路径寻找上，但我们强调，本文所讨论的方法可以应用于任何规划问题，只要其中状态或动作的适用性或可行性会随时间变化，且目标是在尽可能早的时间实现目标。 如果某个问题可以用这些术语来表示，那么就可以高效地计算出任意开始时间的规划方案。

paragraphs.en: Even more broadly, our use of ATFs illustrates one way to perform heuristic search with functions instead of scalar values. We used a function as our cost-so-far g g value, accumulating cost through composition. In the closely related real-time SIPP setting, where an online agent has a fixed time to plan before returning the next action to take, [ 39 ] use ATFs to back up heuristic information from the search frontier, again accumulating cost through function composition, but this time representing the cost-to-go h h .
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，我们对 ATFs 的使用说明了一种用函数而非标量值进行启发式搜索的方法。 我们将一个函数用作当前的 g 值，通过函数组合来累积成本。 在密切相关实时 SIPP 设定中，在线智能体在返回下一个行动前只有固定的规划时间，[ 39 ] 使用 ATFs 从搜索前沿回溯启发式信息，同样通过函数组合累积成本，但这次表示的是剩余成本 h。

paragraphs.en: Our work can be seen as a specialization of TDSP problems or as a generalization of SIPP. To our knowledge, while problems similar to @SIPP have been suggested in remarks by [ 20 ] and [ 16 ] , it has not been explored in prior work. Early work on TDSP by [ 7 ] and [ 12 ] provided a Dijkstra style algorithm for finding the quickest plan between nodes on a graph with time-dependent edge delays. [ 19 ] introduced TDSP with arc closures, effectively safe intervals on edges. Later, [ 20 ] introduced TDSP with parking bans on nodes, and time-dependent edge costs. However, [ 20 ] and other more recent work are focused on the case where the node time windows are ‘parking bans’: where a node can be temporarily closed for waiting, but may still be traversed. They provide a manipulation to their graph that describes how to implement safe intervals on a node by replacing the node with a pair of nodes connected by a single edge corresponding to the safe interval. The combination of the ‘Nodes with no-passing-through periods’ i.e.,safe intervals described in [ 20 ] and the edge functions from [ 19 ] that alternate between a constant duration and infinite duration directly corresponds to our problem.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作可被视为 TDSP 问题的特化，也可视为 SIPP 的推广。 据我们所知，尽管 [ 20 ] 和 [ 16 ] 在评论中提出过与 @SIPP 类似的问题，但此前尚未有研究对此进行探索。 [ 7 ] 和 [ 12 ] 早期关于 TDSP 的研究提出了一种迪杰斯特拉风格的算法，用于在具有时变边延迟的图中寻找节点间的最快路径计划。 [ 19 ] 引入了带有弧闭合的 TDSP，即边上的有效安全区间。 随后，[ 20 ] 提出了带有节点停车禁令和时变边成本的 TDSP。 然而，[ 20 ] 及其他较近期的研究均聚焦于节点时间窗口为“停车禁令”的情况：此时节点可暂时关闭用于等待，但仍可被经过。 他们对其图进行了一种变换，描述了如何通过用一对节点替换原节点来在节点上实现安全区间，这对节点由一条对应于该安全区间的单条边连接。 [ 20 ] 中描述的“禁止穿越时段节点”（即安全区间）与 [ 19 ] 中在恒定持续时间和无限持续时间之间交替变化的边函数相结合，直接对应于我们的问题。

paragraphs.en: In standard temporal planning [ 36 ] , time is considered, but there is no exogenous change. In the SIPP-like domains, where TILs have limited effects (demarcating intervals), situated temporal planning is limited by its duplicate state detection, designed for the general case of task planning — where TILs may have arbitrary state effects — and degrades to keeping all plans to all states.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准的时间规划 [ 36 ] 中，时间会被考虑在内，但不会出现外源性变化。 在类 SIPP 的领域中，TILs 的影响有限（即划定了区间），情境时间规划受到其重复状态检测机制的限制——该机制是为任务规划的通用情况设计的（其中 TILs 可能对状态产生任意影响）——因此会退化为将所有计划保留在所有状态中。

paragraphs.en: In heuristic search, there are currently two popular ways to cope with dynamic worlds. Both are fundamentally based on replanning. The first is ‘incremental search’ methods, such as D*lite [ 26 ] , that speed-up replanning if only a small number of changes have been made to the state space graph since the original plan was found. Such methods are useful only if both the intitial planning and the replanning are fast enough to ensure that the found plans are viable when execution actually begins. The second is ‘real-time search’ methods, such as LSS-LRTA* [ 27 ] , which plan only to a limited horizon. These methods iteratively plan and select a single action at a time for execution, rather than forming a complete plan to the goal. Thus, they are only applicable in forgiving domains in which a goal is always reachable from any state (and thus there are no ‘dead-ends’).
paragraphs.zh: 在启发式搜索中，目前有两种流行的方法可以应对动态世界。 这两种方法从根本上都基于重新规划。 第一种是“增量搜索”方法，例如 D*lite [ 26 ]，当自原始计划找到以来状态空间图仅发生少量变化时，这些方法可以加快重新规划的速度。 只有当初始规划和重新规划都足够快，以确保在执行真正开始时找到的计划仍然可行时，这类方法才有用。 第二种是“实时搜索”方法，例如 LSS-LRTA* [ 27 ]，它们仅规划到有限的未来时间范围。 这些方法迭代地规划和选择单个动作来执行，而不是制定一个通往目标的完整计划。 因此，它们只适用于容错性强的领域，在这些领域中，从任何状态都可以始终到达目标（因此不存在“死胡同”）。

paragraphs.en: This paper explores how a simple change to the typical offline planning problem — making the start time unknown — fundamentally changes how we address the problem. In a dynamic world, it becomes natural to represent plan cost as a function of time. By adapting results from work on the time-dependent shortest path problem, we have seen how these functions can be compactly represented and composed over plans, yielding new variations on best-first heuristic search. We proved these algorithms correct and saw that the size of the resulting plans is at most linear in the problem size. Experimental results illustrated that it is not hard to find SIPP problems where replanning utterly fails, while any-start-time planning appears to be fast enough for practical use.
paragraphs.zh: 本文探讨了如何对典型的离线规划问题做出一个简单的改变——即让开始时间未知——从而从根本上改变我们解决该问题的方式。 在一个动态世界中，将计划成本表示为时间的函数便显得顺理成章。 通过借鉴关于时间依赖最短路径问题的研究成果，我们发现这些函数可以以紧凑的形式表示并在不同计划间组合，从而催生出最佳优先启发式搜索的新变体。 我们证明了这些算法的正确性，并发现所生成计划的规模最多与问题规模呈线性关系。 实验结果表明，要找到那些重规划完全失效的 SIPP 问题并非难事，而任何开始时间规划方法似乎已足够快速，可用于实际场景。

paragraphs.en: For those facing SIPP problems, these results show how any-start-time planning can yield insight into how long a plan is valid, while taking minimal additional overhead. For those building agents that confront a wide variety of planning tasks, they show how to cope with dynamic environments even though planner runtime can be hard to predict. And for those interested in combinatorial search, this work provides representations for heuristic search settings in which g g and f f are better represented as functions instead of scalars.
paragraphs.zh: 对于面临 SIPP 问题的人来说，这些结果表明，任何起始时间的规划方法都能揭示一个计划的有效时长，同时仅产生最小的额外开销。 对于构建需要应对各种规划任务的智能体的人来说，这些结果表明了如何动态处理多变环境，即使规划器的运行时间难以预测。 而对于对组合搜索感兴趣的人来说，这项工作为启发式搜索场景提供了新的表示方法，其中 g 和 f 更适合以函数的形式而非标量的形式来表示。
